expertReview.summary: A 24-megapixel camera from Sony with a Full frame sensor and a 3-inch LCD.
expertReview.bottomLine: This is one of the very highest-rated mirrorless interchangeable lens cameras CR has tested, and it should be compared with DSLRs with similar feature sets when shopping. It rated Excellent in CR's tests for video quality, ease of use, LCD, and image stabilization. Handy features include a second card slot for more onboard memory and a swiveling LCD for shooting at awkward angles. Caveat: This Fujifilm model is heavier than many alternative mirrorless models.
expertReview.highs:
• Takes excellent photos
  • Photos generally were very sharp
  • Images taken in low light (no flash) were very sharp
  • Has full frame sensor
  • Photos displayed almost no visual noise, even in low light
  • Excellent image stabilizer
  • Video quality is excellent, better than most models
  • Very long battery life for a mirrorless
  • Has wide-angle capability with the kit lens
  • Fast start-up time, better than many models
  • Very good and quick at being ready for next shot, better than many models
  • LCD has excellent quality
  • It includes two slots for using two memory cards
  • Captures excellent audio when recording video
  • Can capture audio in stereo
expertReview.lows:
• Its kit lens only has a 2.5x optical zoom range
  • Heavier than the typical Mirrorless
  • Menu abbreviations difficult to understand
  • Lacks built-in flash
expertReview.description:
The Alpha A7 III w/ 28-70mm OSS is a 24-megapixel camera with a kit lens that has a 35mm-equivalent focal length range of 28mm-70mm. It has a 3-inch LCD (921,600 pixels). It also includes an electronic viewfinder, which is helpful when composing in bright light.

Because it accepts interchangeable lenses but does not have a mirror and through-the-lens viewfinder, we consider this model a mirrorless SLR-like camera.

The camera's kit lens has a maximum aperture of f/3.5. The camera's shutter speed range is 30 seconds to 1/8000 of a second.

The Alpha A7 III w/ 28-70mm OSS stores photos and video on SD/SDHC/SDXC/MemoryStick Duo memory cards but has no on-board storage. It captures images as JPEG or RAW files at a top resolution of 6000 x 4000 and UHD-4K-resolution video as MTS, MP4 files at a top resolution of 3840 x 2160 and a frame rate up to 120p or 30i.

Like most digital cameras, this model comes with a proprietary rechargeable battery. This mirrorless has 693 autofocus points, 13 exposure modes, and an exposure compensation control that can be set at +/-5 EV.

The Alpha A7 III w/ 28-70mm OSS measures 5.5 inches wide by 3.9 inches high by 2.9 inches deep, and weighs 36 ounces (2.3 pounds) (with battery, memory card, strap, and tested lens).
expertReview.review:
PHOTO QUALITY. This 24-megapixel mirrorless camera captured images with excellent quality. Pictures were very sharp, which means you can see even tiny details and very subtle patterns in the image. In low-light situations without a flash, pictures were very sharp. We judged this model excellent for outdoor performance, such as shooting landscapes in the daytime; excellent for indoor performance, such as photographing a well-lit basketball game in a gym. And excellent for low-light performance without a flash, such as capturing a birthday party. Photos taken in our low-light performance tests displayed very little image noise; subjects retained correct detail and color.

FLASH. This model has no flash.

LENS. It only has a 2.5x optical zoom lens, less than the standard 3x. The lens also has wide-angle (28mm) capability that's useful for landscapes and group portraits, although you may notice a bit of distortion when you're shooting faces up close, for instance.

IMAGE STABILIZATION. This is an important feature; taking hand-held shots at the telephoto end of the zoom range can generally blur or soften images due to the slight movement of your hands. Shooting telephoto in well-lit scenes, this model did an excellent job of minimizing the effects of camera shake. In low-light settings, it performed excellently and almost never produced blurry photos. Overall, the shake reduction results from our tests were excellent.

SPEED. In terms of performance, the Sony Alpha A7 III w/ 28-70mm OSS powers up very quickly. It has a short interval between shots, which can be important when shooting fast-moving or unpredictable subjects.

VIDEO. The Sony Alpha A7 III w/ 28-70mm OSS takes excellent video. It also captures 4K-UHD video at 3840 x 2160 120p or 30i. As for sound, it captures excellent audio in stereo.

ADDITIONAL COMMENTS. Like most mirrorless models, this camera does include an electronic viewfinder, which means you have flexibility when composing your photo or video; this viewfinder has excellent quality. This mirrorless is much bigger and heavier than most in its class. Although this model has many features and controls, this mirrorless is bulky and heavy, which may not make it the best model if you travel a lot.

attributes.name: Image quality
attributes.description: Image quality is based on tests performed in auto and manual mode using regular photos, low-light photos, and flash photos with consideration of their performance in terms of color reproduction, dynamic range, resolution, distortions, reflections, image stabilization, as well as movie quality.

attributes.name: Ease of use
attributes.description: Ease of use is our evaluation of the camera's controls, manual, response time and focusing.

attributes.name: Video quality
attributes.description: Video quality mostly reflects footage shot in regular and low light, with audio quality and macro (close-up) capability also considered.

attributes.name: LCD quality
attributes.description: LCD quality is a judgment of images viewed under a number of lighting conditions.

attributes.name: Viewfinder
attributes.description: Viewfinder is our evaluation of the quality of the viewfinder, including its accuracy in displaying the framing of the image that will be recorded.

attributes.name: Flash photos
attributes.description: Flash photo tests assess the quality of the built-in flash's light output and evenness of illumination at various distances.

attributes.name: Image stabilization
attributes.description: Image stabilization is our evaluation of the camera's ability to compensate for handheld camera shake. This includes having a built-in image stabilizer in the camera body or the lens it was tested with. The test lens is specified in the camera's brand and model name.

attributes.name: Sensor types
attributes.description: Each camera has a solid-state device which, like film, captures the light coming in through the lens to form an image. The type of sensor is shown for each camera.

attributes.name: Battery life
attributes.description: This indicates the number of high-resolution shots the camera takes with the batteries supplied.

attributes.name: 4K video
attributes.description: Can record 4K video at a minimum resolution of 3840 x 2160.

attributes.name: WiFi
attributes.description: WiFi cameras connect to a wireless network making it possible to transfer photos wirelessly from a digital camera to a Web site or your computer.

attributes.name: Image stabilizer
attributes.description: Image stabilizer shows the type used, lens-based (L) or body-based (B).

attributes.name: LCD size
attributes.description: Diagonal measurement of the LCD monitor screen.

attributes.name: Max. ISO
attributes.description: This is the SLR's highest sensor sensitivity at full resolution.

attributes.name: 35mm equivalent multiplier
attributes.description: Many SLRs have sensors that are smaller than the actual size of one frame of 35mm film, which changes a lens's effective focal length. To determine the equivalent focal length, you multiply the lens's focal length by the appropriate multiplication factor. Most Nikon SLRs have a 1.5x factor, which changes the effective focal length of a 50mm lens to 75mm. An Olympus SLR's 2x factor would change a 50mm lens to 100mm.

attributes.name: Shutter speed range
attributes.description: Shutter speed controls the length of time that the camera lets in light to expose the camera's sensor. This specification shows the range of selectable shutter speeds by defining the minimum and maximum shutter speeds.

attributes.name: Height
attributes.description: The height of the camera body is measured in inches and rounded to the nearest tenth of an inch.

attributes.name: Width
attributes.description: The width of the camera body is measured in inches and rounded to the nearest tenth of an inch.

attributes.name: Depth
attributes.description: The depth of the camera body is measured in inches and rounded to the nearest tenth of an inch.

attributes.name: Total weight
attributes.description: For cameras with interchangeable lenses, it is the total weight of the camera body plus the lens it was tested with. The battery and memory card are also included in the total weight for all cameras.

attributes.name: Swivelling screen
attributes.description: A swivel screen allows you to frame difficult-angled photos in the camera’s LCD screen. It is also called an articulated display, which when used on a tripod allows you to tilt the LCD screen to avoid either having to stand on your toes or to crouch to the level of the LCD screen to be able to see it. A fully articulating screen allows you to shoot selfies and to see how it is framed when standing in front of the camera while shooting photos or video.

attributes.name: Hot shoe
attributes.description: A hot shoe is located on top of the camera and is used to attach a flash unit and other compatible accessories. It is a bracket, which surrounds an electrical connection between camera and accessory for standard, brand-independent flash synchronization.

attributes.name: Memory card
attributes.description: Memory cards indicates the types of memory cards a model can accept if it has a built-in memory-card reader for playback of MP3 audio files or JPEG picture files.

attributes.name: Color space
attributes.description: This refers to computerized models of color ranges that a camera can reproduce. The two most common are sRGB and Adobe RGB. In terms of size, Adobe RGB has a larger color range than sRGB. Another model, ProPhoto RGB, has one of the largest ranges. Color spaces can generally be set via your SLR's menus.

attributes.name: PC flash sync jack
attributes.description: Although the hot shoe is the most common method, you can also use this terminal to connect your flash to your SLR body.

attributes.name: Maximum aperture
attributes.description: The maximum aperture (lens opening) for wide and telephoto shots.  A single number indicates that the camera does not have a zoom lens.

attributes.name: Touch screen
attributes.description: Display that is sensitive to finger contact, letting you select and move screen objects, launch programs, choose from menus, scroll through photo libraries, and the like. Some touchscreens have "multi-touch", letting you use more than one finger to resize and rotate objects.

reliability.infoText: Predicted brand reliability ratings are based on estimated problem rates for newly purchased mirrorless cameras, not covered by an extended warranty or service contract, within the first four years of ownership.

ownerSatisfaction.infoText: Brand owner satisfaction ratings are based on the proportion of members who are extremely likely to recommend their mirrorless camera to their friends and family.

expertReview.summary: Portable Bluetooth wireless noise canceling isolating ear-insert earphones that come with 4 pairs of ear pieces in various sizes, charging cradle/recharger battery/carrying case, USB-A to USB-C connector charging cable, User Guide.
expertReview.bottomLine: This wireless Bluetooth model from 1MORE delivers good sound quality excellent active noise reduction, which combines elements of in-ear and earbud earphones. These earphones have a isolating design and an ambient sound monitoring feature; they will provide some muffling and electronic canceling of external noises and also reduce the amount of sound that escapes from the ear pieces. As such, they are best for those who want highly portable earphones that reduce the amount of noise they hear from their surroundings, or don't want the sound from the ear pieces to disturb others.
expertReview.description: The 1MORE Aero Wireless Earbuds portable Bluetooth wireless noise canceling earphones have a isolating ear-insert design. These iPod/cellphone-centric earphones can be used with the noise canceling feature turned on or off, and are intended for use with iPods, iPads, some other cell phones, as well as standard audio devices. The earphones have an inline microphone and inline remote with and integrated volume, music player function, and call connect/disconnect controls. Additional features include a Either earpiece can be used alone for one ear monitoring of Bluetooth streamed audio and telephone communications but will only monitor one channel (left earphone monitors left channel only, right earphone monitors right channel only). Charging/carrying case has built-in rechargeable battery that the manufacturer claims can be used to recharge the earphone batteries for an additional 15 hrs. of playtime for a total of 20 hrs. with ANC on, or for an additional 21 hrs. of playtime for a total of 28 hrs. with ANC off. Can be recharged via USB cable or optional wireless charging devices. Manufacturer claims water resistance (IPX5). Free 1More Music app download for Apple and Android devices adds additional features. Has five different listening modes that can be selected using the 1More Music app. Touch controls on either earphone operates noise cancellation feature; the default settings can be customized using the app to switch between the different noise cancelling and the ambient sound monitoring options. Has touch controls, defaults are music player play/pause, communications call connect/disconnect, and noise cancelling/ambient sound monitoring control. Automatically pauses audio when one earphone is taken out of ear and resumes when both are put back. Supports unspecified digital voice assistants when used with Bluetooth connected devices that have those features. Has fast charge feature: 15 min of charging will provide 3 hr. of playtime. Earbuds have spatial audio with head-tracking technology, the earbuds track the user's head movement to maintain the center of the sound. Bluetooth connected Apple mobile devices using iOS Version 5 and above will show the battery level. Free 1More Music app download for Apple and Android devices can be used to disable the auto pause feature, customize the headphone touch control functions (play/pause and/or voice control can be swapped for next track, previous track, volume up, and volume down functions), select 12 preset EQ profiles and a custom EQ, check battery levels, update firmware, and run a built-in headphone burn in audio file. The Aero Wireless Earbuds comes with Four pairs of ear pieces in various sizes, charging cradle/recharger battery/carrying case, USB-A to USB-C connector charging cable, User Guide and is covered by a 12-month parts/12-month labor warranty.
expertReview.review:
Design and features:This Bluetooth wireless noise canceling portable ear-insert model provides good sound and excellent active noise reduction. Its ear plug-like design and electronic noise canceling feature reduce both outside noise and sound leaking out into your environment. The headphones work with or without the noise canceling feature being turned on. You can use the noise-canceling feature without listening to music. The Aero Wireless Earbuds has a volume control plus an integrated microphone and player function controls. Additional features include - Either earpiece can be used alone for one ear monitoring of Bluetooth streamed audio and telephone communications but will only monitor one channel (left earphone monitors left channel only, right earphone monitors right channel only). Charging/carrying case has built-in rechargeable battery that the manufacturer claims can be used to recharge the earphone batteries for an additional 15 hrs. of playtime for a total of 20 hrs. with ANC on, or for an additional 21 hrs. of playtime for a total of 28 hrs. with ANC off. Can be recharged via USB cable or optional wireless charging devices. Manufacturer claims water resistance (IPX5). Has five different listening modes that can be selected using the 1More Music app. Touch controls on either earphone operates noise cancellation feature; the default settings can be customized using the app to switch between the different noise cancelling and the ambient sound monitoring options. Has touch controls, defaults are music player play/pause, communications call connect/disconnect, and noise cancelling/ambient sound monitoring control. Automatically pauses audio when one earphone is taken out of ear and resumes when both are put back. Supports compatible digital voice assistants when used with Bluetooth connected devices that have those features. Has fast charge feature: 15 min of charging will provide 3 hr. of playtime. Earbuds have spatial audio with head-tracking technology, the earbuds track the user's head movement to maintain the center of the sound. Bluetooth connected Apple mobile devices using iOS Version 5 and above will show the battery level. Free 1More Music app download for Apple and Android devices can be used to disable the auto pause feature, customize the headphone touch control functions (play/pause and/or voice control can be swapped for next track, previous track, volume up, and volume down functions), select 12 preset EQ profiles and a custom EQ, check battery levels, update firmware, and run a built-in headphone burn in audio file. The Aero Wireless Earbuds comes with 4 pairs of ear pieces in various sizes, charging cradle/recharger battery/carrying case, USB-A to USB-C connector charging cable, User Guide.

Sound quality: We found the Aero Wireless Earbuds delivers sound quality that falls in the good range - it reproduces music and voice reasonably well despite the obvious shortcomings in its sound and excellent active noise reduction. With the noise cancelling mode engaged and the 1More app noise cancelling listening mode set to strong (maximum) and the EQ set to Studio (default) (as received state of the headphone) the bass (as in bass drums, bass guitars, stand-up bass, etc.) has good impact and goes deep, but is a bit prominent and boomy and slightly distorted (slight warble - sounds like it is underwater) with some program material. The midrange is fairly even, but is hazy, somewhat soft, and a bit grainy and congested (think sonic traffic jam). The treble (cymbals, the upper range of violins, etc.) is extended, but the lower and mid treble is a bit subdued and smeared and the upper treble is somewhat subdued. While the sound has a decent sense of liveliness, it is closed (sound-wise it's obvious you have something plugging your ears) and does a decent job of recovering room ambience. Warm character. The overall sound can be summarized as soft, hazy, and a bit bassy. The 1More app tonal presets and EQ adjustments have a noticeable effect on the sound. Noise Canceling: Excellent noise reduction across the entire frequency range with the low frequencies reduced the most. Orientation changes the noise reduction characteristic - when the noise is coming from the front a bit more high-frequency noise can be heard relative to when it's coming from the side or rear. A faint rushing sound can be heard in quiet environments when there is no audio program to drown it out.

Comfort: This is a hybrid ear insert/ear bud design - the earpieces seal the ear canals but they don't insert into the ear canals as far as typical ear insert models, and they are supported by ear bowls like a ear bud model rather than the ear canals. Users with small ear bowls might find that the earphone body feels a bit bulky in their ear bowl, but that they will stay in place during casual use and are stable during vigorous head movement. Users with medium and large sized ear bowls will probably find that this model stays in place with no problems for casual use and that they are fairly stable during vigorous head movement. Hitting the stem that hangs out of the ear can knock an earphone lose and cause it to fall out of the ear.

attributes.name: Sound quality
attributes.description: Represents the tonal accuracy, clarity, detail, ambience, and dynamics of the audio reproduced by the headphone.

attributes.name: Noise reduction
attributes.description: Represents how well the headphone reduces ambient noise when the active noise cancellation feature is activated.

attributes.name: Sensitivity
attributes.description: An assessment of how loud wire connected headphones will play for a given audio input signal level. This is an important consideration if the headphones will be used with audio devices that have relatively low maximum audio output signal levels like some battery powered portables.  Some models have 2 sensitivity levels given: one with the highest selectable setting or noise-reduction switch ON and the other with the lowest selectable setting or noise-reduction switch OFF. Not applicable for wireless headphones that lack a cord connection option.

attributes.name: Type
attributes.description: Over the ear models completely envelop the ear. On-ear models sit on top of the ears. Insert models are inserted into the ear canal. Earbud models rest in the ear outside of the ear canal and may have a portion that extends into the ear canal.

attributes.name: Design
attributes.description: Closed headphones rest on or around the user's ears and rely on a seal between the user's ears and the headphone for proper bass response, and somewhat isolate the user from outside sounds.  Open air models rest on or around the user's ears but do not rely on a seal between the user's ears and headphones for proper bass response and do not isolate the user from outside sounds. Ear insert models are inserted into and are held in place by the ear canal; they rely on a seal between the user's ears and the headphones for proper bass response, and somewhat isolate the user from outside sounds. Earbud models rest in the area outside of the ear canal and may extend into the ear canal but do not rely on the ear canal to be held in place; they do not rely on a seal between the user's ears and headphones for proper bass response and do not isolate the user from outside sounds.

attributes.name: Weight
attributes.description: Reflects the weight, in ounces, of the headphones including the audio cable and batteries, if any.

attributes.name: Cable length
attributes.description: Cable length indicates the approximate length of the cable from the headset or earpiece to the plug, measured in inches.

attributes.name: Battery type
attributes.description: The number and type of batteries used.

attributes.name: Works with noise reduction off
attributes.description: Will operate without the noise-canceling circuitry activated; allows the model to be used as standard headphones if the batteries die.

attributes.name: Integrated microphone
attributes.description: Has an integrated microphone for use with some cell phones or audio players with a recorder function.

attributes.name: Call connect, disconnect control
attributes.description: This allows you to answer or disconnect from a phone call with some cell phones.

attributes.name: Integrated volume control
attributes.description: This allows you to adjust the volume without having to dig into your pocket or purse for a player.

attributes.name: Integrated player control
attributes.description: This allows you to control some player functions (for example: play, pause, track skip) via a control without having to dig into a pocket or purse for a player.

attributes.name: Detachable cable
attributes.description: A detachable cable allows the headphones to be used for noise canceling without the cord being connected to a music or video player, or dangling from the headset.

attributes.name: Monitor function
attributes.description: Has a control that turns off the audio, and in the case of noise canceling models turns off the noise canceling function, so that ambient sounds can be heard.  Useful for hearing ambience like travel announcements without turning off the audio player or removing the headphones.

attributes.name: Noise canceling unit in earpiece
attributes.description: The electronic circuitry for the noise cancelation function is integrated into headphones earpiece rather than incorporated as a separate module that is integrated into the audio cord.

attributes.name: Battery life
attributes.description: As claimed by the manufacturer.
attributes.value:
7 with ANC off
5 with ANC on

attributes.name: Battery recharge time
attributes.description: As claimed by the manufacturer.

attributes.name: Low battery indicator
attributes.description: An indicator to show that the headphone battery power is low and will need to be replaced or recharged.

attributes.name: Warranty (mos.): parts/labor
attributes.description: Warranty is for parts and labor, in months.

attributes.name: Additional features
attributes.description: Additional features for this model.
attributes.value: 2.4 GHz transmission frequency, Bluetooth wireless, around 33 ft operating range.

attributes.name: Included accessories
attributes.description: Indicates what accessories are included.
attributes.value: Four pairs of ear pieces in various sizes, charging cradle/recharger battery/carrying case, USB-A to USB-C connector charging cable, User Guide.

attributes.name: Plug type
attributes.description: The type of connection at the end of the audio cord, which will be plugged into the source component. Most have 1/8-inch standard (3-contact) "mini" jacks that fit portable devices. Models intended for use with newer iPod, iPhone, and some Blackberry smartphones, that have integrated microphones, audio player controls, and call connect/disconnect controls use a 1/8-inch 4-conductor mini jack. The audio function of models with 4-conductor mini jacks may not work properly or consistently with non-iPod/iPhone devices.

reliability.infoText: Predicted brand reliability ratings are based on estimated problem rates for newly purchased noise-canceling headphones, by the end of the 2nd year of ownership.

ownerSatisfaction.infoText: Brand owner satisfaction ratings are based on the proportion of members who are extremely likely to recommend their noise-canceling headphones to their friends and family.

expertReview.bottomLine: This wireless Bluetooth model from 1MORE delivers fair sound quality, which combines elements of in-ear and earbud earphones. These earphones have a non-isolating design, so they're not intended to block out external noise, and some sound from the ear pieces can escape. These highly portable earphones are best for those who listen in quiet environments where disturbing others is not an issue, or for those who want to be able to hear what's going on around them while they use the earphones.
expertReview.description: The 1MORE ComfoBuds portable Bluetooth wireless earphones have a non-isolating earbud design. These iPod/cellphone-centric earphones are intended for use with iPods, iPads, some other cell phones, as well as standard audio devices, and have a claimed reception range of around 33 feet and are intended for use with bluetooth enabled audio devices including cell phones, as well as standard audio devices. The earphones have an inline microphone and inline remote with and integrated volume, music player function, and call connect/disconnect controls. Additional features include an earpiece that can be used alone for one ear monitoring of Bluetooth streamed audio and telephone communications. Charging/carrying case has built-in rechargeable battery that the manufacturer claims can be used to recharge the earphone batteries for an additional 14 hrs. of playtime for a total of 18 hrs. Supports voice control when used with Bluetooth connected devices that have those features. Automatically pauses audio when one earphone is taken out of ear and resumes when both are put back. Bluetooth connected Apple mobile devices using iOS Version 5 and above will show the battery level. Free 1More Music app download for Apple and Android devices can be used to disable the auto pause feature, customize the headphone touch control functions (play/pause and/or voice control can be swapped for any other two sets of functions), check battery levels, update firmware. The ComfoBuds comes with USB-A to USB-C connector charging cable, charging cradle/recharger battery/carrying case. and is covered by a 12-month parts/12-month labor warranty.
expertReview.review:
Design and features:This Bluetooth wireless portable earbud model provides fair sound. Its non-isolating design doesn't muffle outside sounds so you'll be able to hear that door bell ring, train announcement, or car horn when you are wearing these earphones. The ComfoBuds has a volume control plus an integrated microphone and player function controls. Additional features include Either earpiece can be used alone for one ear monitoring of Bluetooth streamed audio and telephone communications. Charging/carrying case has built-in rechargeable battery that the manufacturer claims can be used to recharge the earphone batteries for an additional 14 hrs. of playtime for a total of 18 hrs. Manufacturer claims water and sweat resistance (IPX5). Free 1More Music app download for Apple and Android devices adds additional features. Has touch controls, defaults are music player play/pause, communications call connect/disconnect, and voice control activation. Supports voice control when used with Bluetooth connected devices that have those features. Automatically pauses audio when one earphone is taken out of ear and resumes when both are put back. Bluetooth connected Apple mobile devices using iOS Version 5 and above will show the battery level. Free 1More Music app download for Apple and Android devices can be used to disable the auto pause feature, customize the headphone touch control functions (play/pause and/or voice control can be swapped for any other two sets of functions), check battery levels, update firmware.. This model comes with USB-A to USB-C connector charging cable, charging cradle/recharger battery/carrying case.

Sound quality: We found the ComfoBuds delivers sound quality that falls in the fair range - meaning that it has sonic shortcomings that leave a lot to be desired when listening to music but don't rule it out for dialog and communication. The bass (as in bass drums, bass guitars, stand-up bass, etc.) is subdued and does not go deep, and depending on how these earphones naturally sit in the ears has so-so to decent impact. The midrange (voices, guitars, horns, etc.) is thin, grainy, congested (think sonic traffic jam), harsh, somewhat hazy, and telephone-like. The treble (cymbals, the upper range of violins, etc.) is fairly extended but is prominent and sizzly (sounds that should have a delicate shimmer have a sound reminiscent of bacon frying). The sound also has a good sense of liveliness and is somewhat open--sound-wise it almost seems like you don't have anything plugging up your ears and does not do a good job of recovering room ambience. Cool character. The overall sound can be summarized as thin, harsh, and telephone-like.

Comfort: We found that these earphones are a hybrid ear insert/ear bud design - the earpieces insert into, but don't seal the ear canals, and don't insert as far as typical ear insert models, and they are supported by ear bowls like a ear bud model. Depending on the earbowl size and shape some users might find that it is difficult to position them to optimize their sound quality (resulting in less bass and an even thinner sound). Users with small ear bowls will probably find that they fit and stay in place for casual use. Users with medium and large earbowls will probably find that they fit and stay in place for casual use. Incidental contact with the touch controls can cause unintentional playing and pausing and activating the digital assistant.

expertReview.review:
Design and features:This Bluetooth wireless noise canceling portable ear-insert model provides good sound and excellent active noise reduction. Its ear plug-like design and electronic noise canceling feature reduce both outside noise and sound leaking out into your environment. The headphones work with or without the noise canceling feature being turned on. You can use the noise-canceling feature without listening to music. The ComfoBuds Mini True has a volume control plus an integrated microphone and player function controls. Additional features include that either earpiece can be used alone for one ear monitoring of Bluetooth streamed audio and telephone communications. Charging/carrying case has built-in rechargeable battery that the manufacturer claims can be used to recharge the earphone batteries for an additional 18 hrs. of listening time for a total of 24 hrs. Manufacturer claims water resistance (IPX5). Has three noise cancellation modes that can be selected using the 1More Music app - ANC strong, mild, and wind noise resistant modes. The headphone noise cancellation control default setting switches between ANC Strong, ambient sound monitor (Pass-through), and ANC off modes by touch control on either earbud; the default settings can be customized using the app to switch between the different noise cancelling and the ambient sound monitoring options. Has touch controls, defaults are music player play/pause, communications call connect/disconnect, Noise cancelling/ambient sound monitoring control, and voice control activation. Supports voice control when used with Bluetooth connected devices that have those features. Automatically pauses audio when one earphone is taken out of ear and resumes when both are put back. Has quick charge feature: 10 min of charging will provide 1.5 hr. of playtime. Bluetooth connected Apple mobile devices using iOS Version 5 and above will show the battery level. Free 1More Music app download for Apple and Android devices can be used to disable the auto pause feature, customize the headphone touch control functions (play/pause and/or voice control can be swapped for next track, previous track, volume up, and volume down functions), check battery levels, update firmware, and run a built-in headphone burn in audio file. Personalized audio EQ profiles can be created and stored with the SoundID feature using the 1More Music app. The ComfoBuds Mini True comes with 4 pairs of ear pieces in various sizes, USB-A to USB-C connector charging cable, charging cradle/recharger battery/carrying case, user guide. This model comes with Portable Bluetooth wireless noise canceling isolating ear-insert earphones that come with 4 pairs of ear pieces in various sizes, USB-A to USB-C connector charging cable, charging cradle/recharger battery/carrying case and user guide.

Sound quality: We found the ComfoBuds Mini True delivers sound quality that falls in the good range - it reproduces music and voice reasonably well despite the obvious shortcomings in its sound and excellent active noise reduction. With the noise cancelling mode engaged and set to "Strong" in the 1More app (default mode) the bass (as in bass drums, bass guitars, stand-up bass, etc.) has good impact and goes fairly deep but is somewhat prominent and boomy, and may sound a bit distorted (warbles - sounds like it is underwater) with some program material. The midrange (voices, guitars, horns, etc.) is uneven with a mid-midrange peak, but is somewhat grainy, hazy, dark, and congested (think sonic traffic jam), has a bit of a plastic resonance (something like what you would hear if you talked into a semi-rigid plastic cup), and depending on the program material can be a bit crowded by the bass. The treble (cymbals, the upper range of violins, etc.) is extended, but the lower treble is somewhat subdued while the upper treble is a bit sizzly (sounds that should have a delicate shimmer have a sound reminiscent of bacon frying) and smeared, and a touch prominent. While the sound has a decent sense of liveliness, it is closed (sound-wise it's fairly obvious you have something plugging your ears) and does a decent job of recovering room ambience in the lower-to-mid midrange, but is only so-so throughout the rest of the tonal range. Warm character. The overall sound can be summarized as somewhat bassy, murky, and dull. Noise Canceling: Excellent noise reduction across the entire frequency range with the low frequencies reduced the most. A very faint rushing sound is audible when there is no audio program to mask it.

Comfort: We found that these earphones as typical of in-ear models they produce a sense of pressure in the ear canal opening might be uncomfortable for some. Users with small to medium sized ear bowls will probably find that this model stays in place with no problems for casual use and that they are stable even during fairly vigorous head movement. Users with large sized ear bowls will probably find that this model stays in place with no problems for casual use and that they are stable even during vigorous head movement. Because of the shape and small size of the earphone body some users may find the earphones hard to grasp and fit into place in the ear, and possibly more prone to being dropped when handling them.

expertReview.summary: Portable isolating ear-insert earphones that come with nine pairs of ear pieces in various sizes and types, a mini-plug-to-airplane-jack adapter, a removable shirt clip, and a carrying case.
expertReview.bottomLine: These small, sleek, portable earphones deliver excellent sound with an earplug-like design that limits extraneous noise. They combine elements of in-ear and earbud earphones and also come with nine pairs of earpieces to help you find just the right fit. It's a decent choice for the listener who will not be satisfied with anything less than top notch music and movie soundtrack playback. These earphones have an isolating design; they will both muffle some external noise and limit the amount of sound that escapes from the ear pieces. These highly portable earphones are best for those who want some isolation from outside noises, or don't want the sound from the earpieces to disturb others.
expertReview.description: The 1MORE E1001 Triple Driver portable earphones have an isolating ear-insert design. These iPod/cellphone-centric earphones have a 50-inch audio cord with a modified stereo, 4-contact mini-plug that works with iPods, iPads, iPhones, and some cellphones, but may not be compatible with other audio devices. The earphones have an inline microphone and inline remote with and integrated volume, music player function, and call connect/disconnect controls. The E1001 Triple Driver comes with nine pairs of ear pieces in various sizes and types, a mini-plug-to-airplane-jack adapter, a removable shirt clip, and a carrying case. It is covered by a 12-month warranty.
expertReview.review:
Design and features:These earphones have medium sensitivity so they can provide satisfying volume levels when used with home audio equipment and all but the lowest-powered portable audio devices. The E1001 Triple Driver has an integrated microphone and music player function control that are compatible with iPads, some iPods, and some iPhones and some other cellphones. The call connect/disconnect button can be used with some iPhones and some other cellphones. These earphones may not operate properly with some non-Apple/non-Android mobile devices or other audio equipment. This model comes with nine pairs of ear pieces in various sizes and types, a mini-plug-to-airplane-jack adapter, a removable shirt clip, and a carrying case.

Sound quality: We found the E1001 Triple Driver delivers sound quality that falls in the excellent range; while no headphone is perfect, the sonic shortcomings of this model are minor. The overall sound can best be summarized as fairly clear and nicely balanced. Bass (as in bass drums, bass guitars, stand-up bass, etc.) has good impact, detail, and goes deep, but is slightly prominent. The midrange (voices, guitars, horns, etc.) is fairly even but a touch hazy and grainy. The treble (cymbals, the upper range of violins, etc.) is extended but slightly uneven - the mid treble is a bit prominent while the upper treble is a bit subdued. The sound has a good sense of liveliness and is somewhat open (sound-wise it almost seems like you don't have anything plugging your ears). The sound is very similar to that of the 1MORE Quad Driver, but the bass and treble are not as even.

Comfort: We found that these earphones fit and stay in place with no problem, but they produce a sense of pressure in the ear opening that might be uncomfortable for some.

These iPod/cellphone-centric earphones are intended for use with iPods, iPads, some other cell phones, as well as standard audio devices, and have a claimed reception range of around 33 feet and are intended for use with Bluetooth enabled audio devices including cell phones, as well as standard audio devices. The earphones have an inline microphone and inline remote with xxmusic player function, and call connect/disconnect controls. expertReview.review:
Design and features:This Bluetooth wireless portable ear-insert model provides very good sound. Although it lacks active noise reduction, the ear plug-like design helps to reduce both outside noise and sound leaking out into your environment. The PistonBuds has an integrated microphone and player function controls. Additional features include Either earpiece can be used alone for one ear monitoring of Bluetooth streamed audio and telephone communications, but only right earphone offers music player play/pause and call connect/disconnect control. Charging/carrying case has built-in rechargeable battery that the manufacturer claims can be used to recharge the earphone batteries up to almost 4-3/4 times (to add 16.5 hrs. of playtime for a total of 20 hrs.). Manufacturer claims water resistance (IPX4). Has touch controls for music player play/pause, call connect/disconnect, and digital voice assistant activation. Has Bluetooth connection, low battery, and power off alert tones. Supports digital voice assistants when used with Bluetooth connected devices that have those features. Bluetooth connected Apple mobile devices using iOS Version 5 and above will show the battery level. This model comes with three pairs of ear pieces in various sizes, USB-A to USB-C connector charging cable, charging cradle/recharger and battery/carrying case.

Sound quality: We found the PistonBuds delivers sound quality that falls in the very good range - it reproduces music and voice very well although it does have some noticeable sonic quirks. The bass (as in bass drums, bass guitars, stand-up bass, etc.) has good impact and goes deep, but is prominent and boomy, and depending on the program material, can somewhat overwhelm the midrange. The midrange (voices, guitars, horns, etc.) is fairly even, but is somewhat grainy, and a bit hazy and congested (think sonic traffic jam), and a touch edgy. The treble (cymbals, the upper range of violins, etc.) is extended but is a a bit smeared (sounds that should have a delicate shimmer sound blurred) and sizzly (sounds that should have a delicate shimmer have a sound reminiscent of bacon frying). The sound also has a decent sense of liveliness and is somewhat open--sound-wise it almost seems like you don't have anything plugging up your ears and does a good job of recovering room ambience. Mixed character - warm bass with neutral midrange and coolish treble. The overall sound can be summarized as bassy, and somewhat grainy and a bit hazy.

Comfort: We found that these earphones as typical of in-ear models produce a sense of pressure in the ear canal opening that might be uncomfortable for some. Users will probably find that this model stays in place with no problems for casual use and that they are stable during fairly vigorous head movement. Hitting the stem that hangs out of the ear can knock an earphone lose and cause it to fall out of the ear. Some users might find tapping the earphone controls drives the earphones farther into the ear canal and may cause ear discomfort.

expertReview.summary: Portable Bluetooth wireless noise canceling isolating ear-insert earphones that come with 4 pairs of ear pieces in various sizes, USB-A to USB-C connector charging cable, charging cradle/recharger battery/carrying case, user guide, sticker.
expertReview.bottomLine: This wireless Bluetooth model from 1MORE delivers good sound quality excellent active noise reduction, which combines elements of in-ear and earbud earphones. These earphones have a isolating design and an ambient sound monitoring feature; they will provide some muffling and electronic canceling of external noises and also reduce the amount of sound that escapes from the ear pieces. As such, they are best for those who want highly portable earphones that reduce the amount of noise they hear from their surroundings, or don't want the sound from the ear pieces to disturb others.
expertReview.description: The 1MORE PistonBuds Pro True Wireless Active Noise Canceling portable Bluetooth wireless noise canceling earphones have a isolating ear-insert design. These iPod/cellphone-centric earphones can be used with the noise canceling feature turned on or off, and are intended for use with iPods, iPads, some other cell phones, as well as standard audio devices. The earphones have an inline microphone and inline remote with and integrated volume, music player function, and call connect/disconnect controls. Additional features include either earpiece can be used alone for one ear monitoring of Bluetooth streamed audio and telephone communications. Charging/carrying case has built-in rechargeable battery that the manufacturer claims can be used to recharge the earphone batteries for an additional 15 hrs. of playtime for a total of 20 hrs. with ANC on, or for an additional 22.5 hrs. of playtime for a total of 30 hrs. with ANC off. Manufacturer claims water resistance (IPX5). Has two noise cancellation modes that can be selected using the 1More Music app - ANC strong and wind noise resistant modes. The headphone noise cancellation control default setting switches between ANC Strong, ambient sound monitor (Pass-through), and ANC off modes by touch control on either earbud; the default settings can be customized using the app to switch between the different noise cancelling and the ambient sound monitoring options. Has touch controls, defaults are music player play/pause, communications call connect/disconnect, noise cancelling/ambient sound monitoring control, and voice control activation. Supports voice control when used with Bluetooth connected devices that have those features. Automatically pauses audio when one earphone is taken out of ear and resumes when both are put back. Has quick charge feature: 5 min of charging will provide 1 hr. of playtime. Bluetooth connected Apple mobile devices using iOS Version 5 and above will show the battery level. Free 1More Music app download for Apple and Android devices can be used to disable the auto pause feature, customize the headphone touch control functions (play/pause and/or voice control can be swapped for next track, previous track, volume up, and volume down functions), select preset EQ profiles, check battery levels, update firmware, and run a built-in headphone burn in audio file. The PistonBuds Pro True Wireless Active Noise Canceling comes with 4 pairs of ear pieces in various sizes, USB-A to USB-C connector charging cable, charging cradle/recharger battery/carrying case, user guide, sticker and is covered by a 12-month parts/12-month labor warranty.
expertReview.review:
Design and features:This Bluetooth wireless noise canceling portable ear-insert model provides good sound and excellent active noise reduction. Its ear plug-like design and electronic noise canceling feature reduce both outside noise and sound leaking out into your environment. The headphones work with or without the noise canceling feature being turned on. You can use the noise-canceling feature without listening to music. The PistonBuds Pro True Wireless Active Noise Canceling has a volume control plus an integrated microphone and player function controls. Additional features include - Either earpiece can be used alone for one ear monitoring of Bluetooth streamed audio and telephone communications. Charging/carrying case has built-in rechargeable battery that the manufacturer claims can be used to recharge the earphone batteries for an additional 15 hrs. of playtime for a total of 20 hrs. with ANC on, or for an additional 22.5 hrs. of playtime for a total of 30 hrs. with ANC off. Manufacturer claims water resistance (IPX5). Has two noise cancellation modes that can be selected using the 1More Music app - ANC strong and wind noise resistant modes. The headphone noise cancellation control default setting switches between ANC Strong, ambient sound monitor (Pass-through), and ANC off modes by touch control on either earbud; the default settings can be customized using the app to switch between the different noise cancelling and the ambient sound monitoring options. Has touch controls, defaults are music player play/pause, communications call connect/disconnect, noise cancelling/ambient sound monitoring control, and voice control activation. Supports voice control when used with Bluetooth connected devices that have those features. Automatically pauses audio when one earphone is taken out of ear and resumes when both are put back. Has quick charge feature: 5 min of charging will provide 1 hr. of playtime. Bluetooth connected Apple mobile devices using iOS Version 5 and above will show the battery level. Free 1More Music app download for Apple and Android devices can be used to disable the auto pause feature, customize the headphone touch control functions (play/pause and/or voice control can be swapped for next track, previous track, volume up, and volume down functions), select preset EQ profiles, check battery levels, update firmware, and run a built-in headphone burn in audio file. The PistonBuds Pro True Wireless Active Noise Canceling comes with 4 pairs of ear pieces in various sizes, USB-A to USB-C connector charging cable, charging cradle/recharger battery/carrying case, user guide, sticker.

Sound quality: We found the PistonBuds Pro True Wireless Active Noise Canceling delivers sound quality that falls in the good range - it reproduces music and voice reasonably well despite the obvious shortcomings in its sound and excellent active noise reduction. With the noise cancelling mode engaged and set to "Strong" and the preset EQ set to "Default" in the 1More app (default mode) the bass (as in bass drums, bass guitars, stand-up bass, etc.) has good impact and goes fairly deep but is a bit boomy and a touch prominent. The midrange (voices, guitars, horns, etc.) is hazy, somewhat grainy, a bit congested (think sonic traffic jam), and the upper midrange (voices, guitars, horns, etc.) is a bit muted. The treble (cymbals, the upper range of violins, etc.) is extended, but is somewhat smeared, and a bit subdued and sizzly (sounds that should have a delicate shimmer have a sound reminiscent of bacon frying). While the sound has a decent sense of liveliness, it is closed (sound-wise it's obvious you have something plugging your ears) and doesn't do a good job of recovering room ambience. Warm character. The overall sound can be summarized as a bit bassy and somewhat soft. The EQ settings of the app do have a noticeable effect on the sound of these earphones. Noise Canceling: Excellent noise reduction across the entire frequency range with the low frequencies reduced the most. Orientation does not significantly change the noise reduction characteristic. A very faint rushing noise can be heard when there is no audio program to drown it out.

Comfort: As typical of in-ear models they produce a sense of pressure in the ear canal opening that might be uncomfortable for some. Users with small ear bowls might find that the earphone body feels a bit bulky in their ear bowl and that they feel like they may lever out of place, but that they will stay in place during casual use and are stable during fairly vigorous head movement. Users with medium to larger sized ear bowls will probably find that this model stays in place with no problems for casual use and that they are stable during fairly vigorous head movement.

expertReview.bottomLine: This iPod/iPad/cellphone-centric model from 1MORE delivers excellent sound quality and is a decent choice for the listener who will not be satisfied with anything less than top notch music and movie soundtrack playback. These earphones have an isolating design; they will both muffle some external noise and limit the amount of sound that escapes from the ear pieces. These highly portable earphones are best for those who want some isolation from outside noises, or don't want the sound from the earpieces to disturb others.
expertReview.description: The 1MORE Quad Driver portable earphones have an isolating ear-insert design. These iPod/cellphone-centric earphones have a 50-inch audio cord with a modified stereo 4 contact mini-plug that works with iPods, iPads, iPhones, and some cellphones, but may not be compatible with other audio devices. The earphones have an inline microphone and inline remote with and integrated volume, music player function, and call connect/disconnect controls. The Quad Driver comes with nine pairs of ear pieces in various sizes and types, a mini-plug-to-1/4-inch-plug adapter, a mini-plug-to-airplane-jack adapter, a removable shirt clip, and a carrying case. It is covered by a 12-month warranty.
expertReview.review:
Design and features:These earphones have medium-high sensitivity so they can provide satisfying volume levels when used with home audio equipment and even lower-powered portable audio devices. The Quad Driver has an integrated microphone and volume, music player function, and call connect/disconnect controls that are compatible with iPads, some iPods, and some iPhones and some other cellphones. The call connect/disconnect button can be used with some iPhones and some other cellphones. These earphones may not operate properly with some non-Apple/non-Android mobile devices or other audio equipment. This model comes with nine pairs of ear pieces in various sizes and types, a mini-plug-to-1/4-inch-plug adapter, a mini-plug-to-airplane-jack adapter, a removable shirt clip, and a carrying case.

Sound quality: We found the Quad Driver delivers sound quality that falls in the excellent range; while no earphone is perfect, the sonic shortcomings of this model are minor. The overall sound can best be summarized as fairly clear and evenly balanced. Bass (as in bass drums, bass guitars, stand-up bass, etc.) has good impact and goes deep. The midrange (voices, guitars, horns, etc.) is fairly even but a touch hazy and grainy. The treble (cymbals, the upper range of violins, etc.) is extended and fairly even, but the upper treble is a bit sizzly (sounds that should have a delicate shimmer have a sound a bit reminiscent of bacon frying). The sound has a decent sense of liveliness and is somewhat open -- sound-wise it almost seems like you don't have anything plugging up your ears. The sound is very similar to that of the 1MORE E1001 Triple Driver, but the bass and treble are more even.

Comfort: We found that these earphones fit and stay in place with no problem, but as typical of in-ear models they produce a sense of pressure in the ear opening that might be uncomfortable for some.

Design and features:This Bluetooth wireless noise canceling home/studio-style over-ear model provides very good sound and excellent active noise reduction. Its closed design and electronic noise canceling feature reduce both outside noise and sound leaking out into your environment. The headphones work with or without the noise canceling feature being turned on. You can use the noise-canceling feature without listening to music, and the audio cable can be detached to get it out of the way when the headphones are being used for noise reduction only. The headphones have medium high sensitivity so they can provide satisfying volume levels when used with home audio equipment and even lower powered portable audio devices. The SonoFlow has a volume control plus an integrated microphone and player function controls. Additional features include - a detachable audio cable. Ear cups fold and swivel to flat for ease of carrying and storage. The headphone noise cancellation control setting switches between ANC, ambient sound monitor (Pass-through), and ANC off modes by button control on right ear cup; these settings can also be selected by using the 1More Music app. When used with audio cable connected, headphone power is forced off and headphones are used in passive (unpowered) mode - use of any button control or ANC sound modes is disabled. Has button controls for music player transport, call connect/disconnect, ambient noise/noise cancellation/ on/off, Bluetooth volume control, and digital voice assistant activation. Has quick charge feature: 5 min of charging will provide 5 hrs. of playtime. Bluetooth connected Apple mobile devices using iOS Version 5 and above will show the battery level. Free 1More Music app download for Apple and Android devices can be used to change the headphone tonal balance, check battery levels, update firmware, and run a built-in headphone burn in audio file. The SonoFlow comes with a detachable 49-inch long standard audio cable, USB-A to USB-C charging cable, Carrying case, User guide.

Sound quality: We found the SonoFlow delivers sound quality that falls in the very good range - it reproduces music and voice reasonably well despite the obvious shortcomings in its sound and excellent active noise reduction. With the ANC on and the EQ set to Studio (default) in the 1More app the bass (as in bass drums, bass guitars, stand-up bass, etc.) has good impact and goes deep, but is a bit prominent and tubby. The midrange (voices, guitars, horns, etc.) is fairly even but is somewhat grainy, hazy and congested (think sonic traffic jam), and a touch plasticky. The treble (cymbals, the upper range of violins, etc.) is fairly extended but is a touch subdued and sizzly (sounds that should have a delicate shimmer have a sound reminiscent of bacon frying), and a bit smeared. While the sound has a good sense of liveliness, it is somewhat closed (sound-wise it's fairly obvious you have something plugging your ears) and does a decent job of recovering room ambience. Warmish character. The overall sound can best be summarized as somewhat grainy and hazy and a bit bassy. Noise Canceling: Excellent noise reduction across the entire frequency range with the low frequencies reduced the most. Orientation changes the noise reduction characteristic - when the noise is coming from the front a bit less low-frequency noise can be heard relative to when it's coming from the side or rear. A very faint rushing sound can be heard in quiet environments when there is no audio program to drown it out.

Comfort: We found that these headphones produce a sense of moderate pressure around the ears. As typical of over-ear models the ear pads might feel hot and/or sticky after prolonged use. Users with larger heads might find that the headband does not have enough adjustment range to allow the ear cups rest properly over the ears and/or that the headband presses uncomfortably on the top of the head. Users with larger ears might find that the over-the-ear fit of the ear pads feel cramped, or that the ear pads sit on, rather than around their ears; in that case the less-than-ideal fit around the ears might interfere with the ear pad seal and reduce the noise reduction capabilities of the headphone. Some users may find that when they lean far forward the headphones feel unstable and shift forward, possibly to the point of falling off. When wearing this model while walking the muffled vibrations from each foot step can be heard slightly through the headphones regardless of whether or not the headphones are in noise cancelling mode. When the audio cord is used the sound of it rubbing on clothing may be faintly heard through the headphones.

expertReview.summary: Portable Bluetooth wireless isolating ear-insert earphones that come with seven pairs of ear pieces in various sizes and types, four pairs of removable ear bowl supports in various sizes, a USB charging cable, a charging cradle/carrying case with built-in battery, and a carrying bag.
expertReview.bottomLine: This  wireless  Bluetooth  model from 1MORE is totally wireless - the left and right earpieces are totally separate from each other and are not connected together by a cable. They deliver Excellent active noise reduction and Fair sound quality, and while casual listeners may find it adequate for movie and TV dialog it's not a good choice for those whose focus is music. These earphones have an isolating design with an ambient sound monitoring feature. They will provide some muffling and electronic canceling of external noises, but can be set to allow the user to hear what going on in their surroundings. As such, they are best for those who want to be able to choose between some isolation from outside noises and being able to hear what's going on around them.
expertReview.description: The 1MORE True Wireless ANC portable Bluetooth wireless noise-canceling earphones have an isolating ear-insert design. These earphones can be used with the noise canceling feature turned on or off, are intended for use with Bluetooth enabled audio devices, and have a reception range of around 33 feet. They have a built-in microphone and integrated Bluetooth volume, music player function, and call connect/disconnect controls. Additional features include an auto pause feature that stops audio playback when either earphone is taken out of an ear and support for various digital voice assistants when used with Bluetooth capable devices that have those features. The True Wireless ANC comes with seven pairs of ear pieces in various sizes and types, four pairs of removable ear bowl supports in various sizes, a USB charging cable, a Qi wireless charging compatible charging cradle/carrying case with built-in battery, and a carrying bag. It is covered by a 12-month warranty.
expertReview.review:
Design and features:The earphones work with or without the noise canceling feature being turned on, and you can use the noise-canceling feature without listening to music. The True Wireless ANC has integrated microphones as well as music player and call connect/disconnect controls that work with paired Bluetooth devices, and controls to switch between noise canceling and ambient sound monitoring. Additional features include an auto pause feature that stops audio playback when either earphone is taken out of an ear, support for Apple Siri and Google Assistant digital voice assistants when used with Bluetooth capable devices that have those features, and wireless recharging with optional Qi-compatible wireless charging mats. This model comes with seven pairs of ear pieces in various sizes and types, four pairs of removable ear bowl supports in various sizes, a USB charging cable, a charging cradle/carrying case with built-in battery that the manufacturer claims can be used to recharge the earphone batteries approximately 2-2/3 times between its own charges, and a carrying bag.

Sound quality: We found the True Wireless ANC delivers sound quality that falls in the fair range - meaning that it has sonic shortcomings that leave a lot to be desired when listening to music but don't rule it out for dialog and communication and excellent active noise reduction. With either of the noise cancelling modes engaged the bass (as in bass drums, bass guitars, stand-up bass, etc.) has good impact and goes deep, but is prominent and boomy. The midrange (voices, guitars, horns, etc.) is somewhat even, but it is muffled and somewhat congested and a bit grainy. The treble (cymbals, the upper range of violins, etc.) is fairly extended but is generally subdued and the mid to upper treble is a bit sizzly. The sound lacks liveliness and it is closed (sound-wise it's fairly obvious you have something plugging your ears) and does a so-so job of recovering room ambience (the sense of the acoustic space in which the audio program that's being listened to was recorded). Warm character. The overall sound can be summarized as bassy and muffled. Noise Canceling: Excellent noise reduction across the entire frequency range with the low frequencies reduced the most. The noise cancelling settings and the ambient monitor setting produce a very noticeable rushing sound that is audible when there is no audio program material to drown it out and during quiet audio passages.

Comfort: As typical of in-ear models they produce a sense of pressure in the ear canal opening might be uncomfortable for some. Users with small earbowls might find that the earphone body feels a bit bulky in their earbowl and that they stick out too far and feel like they may lever out of place and are mostly held in place by the section of the earphone that is inserted in the ear canal, but that they will generally stay in place during casual use. Users with medium, and larger sized ear bowls will probably find that this model fits and stays in place with no problems for casual use and that they are very stable even during vigorous head movement. Some uses might tapping the earphone to switch between the anc and ambient sound monitoring functions drives the earphone further into the ear bowl and/or canal and causes ear discomfort.

expertReview.summary:
This 3 Embers medium sized grill has the following:
  • 480 sq. in. of cooking area.
  • 4 main burner(s)
  • Converts with natural-gas kit
expertReview.bottomLine: This model aced CR's sturdiness test, suggesting that it should weather multiple seasons' moves into and out of storage. It has a sealed frame with a single door and two pullout drawers, and a glass viewing window that lets you check your steak without opening the lid and allowing the heat to escape. It also earns an Excellent rating for evenness, making it easy to cook a slew of burgers and hot dogs simultaneously.
expertReview.highs:
• Evenness performance is excellent
  • Preheat performance is very good
  • Reaches high cooking temperatures quickly
  • Very Good temperature range from low to high setting
  • Excellent sturdiness
  • This grill is less likely to flare up with high fat content foods, but a full grill may still flare up.
expertReview.lows: This model had no discernible flaws in its performance.
expertReview.review:
Evenness Performance: This model had excellent performance in our evenness tests of preheat, high and low tempertures, which measures heating evenness over the grill's surface using thermocouples.

Preheat performance: This model had very good performance in our preheat performance test, which measures the temperature over the grill's surface after 10 minutes using thermocouples. It also gives an indication how quickly the grill reaches its maximium temperature.

Indirect Cooking: This model had good performance in our indirect-cooking test, which gauges how well grills slow-cook foods when only some of the burners are on and the food isn' t placed directly over the flame.

Temperature range: This model had very good performance in our temperature-range test, which measures the difference between the average temperatures with all burners on high and all burners on low using thermocouples. It also gives an indication on how low the grill can go.

Convenience: This model was judged good for construction materials, useful accessory burners, and other ease of use aspects.

attributes.description: Evenness of heating over the grill's surface at the highest and lowest setting using all main burners plus the evenness after a 10 minute preheat, using thermocouples.

attributes.description: Reflects how wide a temperature span the grill offers by comparing temperatures at the high setting and lowest setting possible.

attributes.description: This indicates grill temperature when only one or two of the burners are on, to represent a cooking task where the food is placed between or alongside the direct flame.

attributes.description: Most grills have a mechanical igniter of either the push-button or rotary design. More convenient is a battery-operated electronic igniter, which usually ignites the gas on the first try. Some grills also have lighting holes, on the side of or beneath the grill, that can be used with a match should the igniter fail.

attributes.description: Number of casters a grill has to move it around.

attributes.description: Many gas (that is, propane gas) grills also come in a natural-gas version, usually with a different model number that includes an "N" for natural gas. Some models have a conversion kit (as standard or optional equipment) that requires some modification to a propane grill in order to use it with natural gas. If you're unfamiliar or uncomfortable with these modifications, you may need to hire a professional to do the job your retailer should be able to help with arrangements. The grill also would, of course, require its own gas line.

attributes.name: Type of grates
attributes.description: Type of grates

attributes.name: All or mostly stainless
attributes.description: Includes more than just a panel or other trim. Based on our limited tests, nonmagnetic stainless is less likely to corrode.

attributes.name: Long-warranty burners
attributes.description: While burners remain the grill's most-replaced part, most are warranted for only 3 to 5 years. Better burners are covered for 10 years or more.

attributes.name: Side burner
attributes.description: A side burner, which resembles a gas-stove burner and has its own heat control, is handy if you want to cook vegetables or sauce without leaving the grill.  A side burner could also be an infrared burner used for searing.

attributes.name: Infrared burner
attributes.description: Gas burner that uses infrared technology (ceramic burner, plates and screens, or troughs as some examples) for cooking. An indirect flame is used for cooking food. Burner can be located as the main burner, side burner, rotisserie burner, or any combination of burners.

attributes.name: Rotisserie
attributes.description: This generally means that the grill comes with a dedicated rotisserie burner; the motor and spit are usually purchased separately. A dedicated rotisserie burner is usually located on the back of the firebox, slightly above the cooking grates; some models use the grill's main burner(s). This feature allows you to roast meat (a whole chicken, for example) very evenly, yielding a flavor that some people prefer to that of grilled food. .

attributes.name: Side shelf material
attributes.description: Shelves are usually made of stainless steel or painted steel (some using a powder-coating process), though a few are made of  plastic. Plastic and stainless steel may prove more durable than paint coatings. If nothing is displayed, the unit does not have side shelves.

attributes.name: Fuel gauge
attributes.description: Located on the propane tank or the grill itself, this reveals at a glance how much propane remains in the tank.

attributes.name: Comes with griddle
attributes.description: Comes with griddle.

attributes.name: Additional features
attributes.description: Additional features can be a lights, utensil hooks, etc.

expertReview.summary: This 3G Cardio is a folding treadmill that has a shipping weight of 222 pounds. It has a footprint of 76 x 34 inches. The maximum specified user weight for this machine is 350 lbs.
expertReview.bottomLine: The 3G Cardio 80i is a Recommended folding model that scored Very Good overall. The low-profile, medium-sized console has a hard-plastic, glossy finish and a modern clean presentation. The white-on-blue, single-window display clearly shows exercise data in a well organized fashion. There is no having to guess what the controls do; they are well labelled and clearly organized. Exercise intensity profiles are printed on the console and presented graphically in the display as you scroll through the program list. Simply spinning the unique quick-dial control makes changing speeds not only easy but fun! Ancillary incline and speed controls on the side handgrips are convenient. The highlight of this treadmill is its innovative fold-flat design. Unlocking hubs at the front of the frame and releasing the console locking pins, allows the uprights and console to fold down on top of the deck for a 10 inch thick package with the ability to store under a bed. This may not be as easy as suggested however, since it must be lifted at a slight angle in order to slide it under the bed. Considering its light weight and transformer-like capability, the 80i fared well in our durability test showing very minor deck wear, comparable to other more substantially built treadmills.
expertReview.highs:
• One or more cup-holders are provided.
  • Ancillary speed control provides an additional and convenient speed control.
  • Ancillary incline control provides an additional and convenient incline control.
  • Custom programs provide the ability to create and save a workout profile.
expertReview.lows: • No magazine rack or reading shelf is provided.
expertReview.review: Controls: The incremental, speed-control buttons are oriented as expected with the increase button on the top or right-hand side. They are positioned appropriately being right next to one another. The button size is considered excellent, making it easy to operate while exercising. An alternative set of quick speed-controls provide the ability to select every-other, whole-number speed, using a limited set of control buttons. The incremental, incline-control buttons are oriented as expected with the increase button on the top or right-hand side. They are positioned appropriately, being adjacent to one another. The button size is considered fair making it somewhat difficult to operate while exercising. An alternative set of quick incline-controls provide the ability to select a few, whole-number inclines using a limited set of control buttons. Display: The monitor displays white characters on a blue colored background. The size of the characters showing the "speed" is considered good and the size of the characters showing "incline" is considered poor. All exercise statistics are presented in the same physical window. Programs: This machine comes equipped with 8 built-in exercise programs. A list of programs is convenienty shown on the console. A graphical illustration of each program's exercise profile is shown on the console. Ergonomics: The step-up height to the running deck is 6.25 inches from the floor. This machine does not have a front handgrip surface. A partial side-handrail provides both security and easy access. Exercise: The minimum incline for this machine is 1 percent. The maximum incline is 9 percent. The manufacturer-stated, top speed is 11 mph. A top speed of 11.3 mph was measured. Construction: This machine features a motor with a 3 hp rating. The lack of floor levelers means there is no built-in leveling feature. Performance on our durability test - simulating a half-year of usage - was very good, showing only minor signs of wear. Safety: The "stop" button size was considered fair. The plastic tang style safety-key disengaged without issue when a user approached the end of the running belt, which stopped the motor and running belt as expected. After the safety key was removed from its receptacle, the running belt coasted to a stop from a speed of 6 mph, in 5.1 seconds. The average stopping time for all tested treadmills is 5.7 seconds. When walking within reach of the control console, the motor housing which resides at the front of the running belt, created some interference with a user's feet, but it was infrequent.

expertReview.summary: This portable air purifier from 3M Filtrete is primarily filter-based and has a filter indicator and programmable timer, and 4 speeds. It’s designed for floor or tabletop use in a large room. and weighs 20.3 pounds.
expertReview.bottomLine: “Middling” best describes this 3M Filtrete Elite portable air purifier. Although the machine quickly cleans the air in a room when running at high speed, performance at its low speed rates only Fair, CR tests found. It’s also louder than most of the air purifiers CR tested; you wouldn’t want it in a bedroom when you’re trying to get shut-eye. And it's relatively heavy and has high operating costs.
expertReview.highs:
• Effective at removing dust, smoke, and pollen at its highest speed, important quickly cleaning the air in the room.

  • Easy to operate its controls, carry it, and clean or replace its filter(s).
  • Relatively low filter costs.
  • Has a filter indicator, which lets you know when it's time to change/clean the main filter.
  • Has a carrying handle.
  • Has a programmable timer.
expertReview.lows:
• Not very effective at removing dust, smoke, and pollen at its lowest speed, which could affect your comfort if you’ll run the unit in your bedroom at night.
  • Relatively loud on its lowest speed.
  • Very noisy even for an air purifier running at its highest speed.
  • Relatively high annual costs, which includes routine filter replacement (if any) and annual operating costs.
  • Relatively high operating costs.

expertReview.highs:

  • Has SpO2 sensor

  • Wireless non-magnetic charging dock makes it easy to put on charger
