expertReview.description: The 3Plus Vibe Pro is a smartwatch compatible with iOS and Android and includes real-time heart rate monitor, steps, sleep and calories. It has a touchscreen display, always-on display capability, on-screen battery indicator, and a wireless non-magnetic charging dock. It has phone notifications, vibration alerts, inactivity alerts that remind you to move if you are sitting for a long time. It has a find my phone and find my watch features. Has Connected music (can control playback of music stored on your smartphone), and has Standalone music (can control playback of music stored on your smartwatch without needing your smartphone). Has Standalone GPS (can connect to GPS without needing your smartphone). The manufacturer offers changeable straps and weather at-wrist. Has built-in TRUE GPS which provides you real routes on the map when you exercise outdoors, Vibe PRO also has a compass and barometric altimeter for hikers and mountaineers with better tracking of your activity and direction guidance, and has activity tracking. It has multi-sport tracking features: outdoor running, indoor running, outdoor cycling, indoor cycling, walking, freestyle, ping pong, basketball, soccer, badminton, cricket, hiking, trail running, pool swimming, open water and stair climbing. Its dimensions are 2.1 x 2 x 0.5 inches (LxWxD) and it weighs 1.4 ounces.
expertReview.review: Overall this model was somewhat easy to use, not as accurate as most models for counting steps, and good at measuring heart-rate accuracy. With recent version smartphones, our experts found it very easy to pair, somewhat easy to interact with, and very easy to connect to charger. The watch face was good in our scratch resistance hardness test and will show scratches with wear-and-tear over time. It passed our water immersion test at 164 feet for 30 minutes.

attributes.name: Ease of use
attributes.description: Considers how easy it is to access core device functions and perform key tasks, such as accessing messages, calendars and alarms, and app notifications, as well as pair the smartwatch with another device for the first time. Display performance under various lighting conditions also factors into this score.

attributes.name: Versatility
attributes.description: Indicates features that increase a smartwatch's utility or capabilities. These include how many sensors it has, if it has cellular connectivity, can you make and receive calls at-wrist, does it have inactivity alerts, GPS tracking, and other useful features.

attributes.name: Health

attributes.name: Step-count performance
attributes.description: How well did the smartwatch count our testers actual steps.

attributes.name: Heart-rate performance
attributes.description: How well did the smartwatch measure our testers actual heart rate.

attributes.name: Scratch test
attributes.description: Durability is a greater concern for smartwatches than for any other personal electronics device because, by design, they’re exposed to the elements and are vulnerable to any hazards that your arms encounter. We use the Mohs scale, which compares the scratch resistance of minerals relative to one another using 10 minerals of increasing hardness as reference points. It rates talc as 1 and goes all the way up to diamond at a 10 rating. Our score is a reflection on how well the smartwatch crystal performed on the Mohs test, as well as against other smartwatches in our Ratings.

attributes.name: Water resistance test
attributes.description: How resistant the watch is to submersion in water, as tested by subjecting the device to a water pressure equivalent to the depth the manufacturer claims the smartwatch can withstand.

attributes.name: Ease of interaction
attributes.description: An evaluation of the steps necessary to access core device functions and perform key tasks, such as accessing messages, calendars and alarms, and app notifications.

attributes.name: Readability in bright light
attributes.description: How easy it is to read the display (time, texts, etc.) under bright lighting conditions, such as in sunlight.

attributes.name: Readability in low light
attributes.description: How is easy it is to read the display (time, texts, etc.) in relative darkness, indoors or at night.

attributes.name: Ease of pairing
attributes.description: An assessment of the steps necessary for pairing the smartwatch with another device for the first time.

attributes.name: Crystal type
attributes.description: The material used to protect the display. Often it’s made of a mineral such as sapphire or quartz, or other materials such as glass or plastic.

attributes.name: Case material
attributes.description: Primary material used to manufacture the case, excluding the display.

attributes.name: Diameter
attributes.description: The diameter of the case, measured to nearest tenth of an inch.

attributes.name: Display size
attributes.description: Size of the active screen, to the nearest tenth of an inch.

attributes.name: Weight
attributes.description: Weight of watch in ounces.

attributes.name: Thickness
attributes.description: Thickness of the watch measured to the nearest tenth of an inch.

attributes.name: Cellular
attributes.description: Has the ability to connect to a cellular network without a smartphone.

attributes.name: Standalone GPS
attributes.description: Connects to GPS satellites to measure distance you moved during various exercises without having a smartphone present.

attributes.name: Standalone music
attributes.description: Allows music stored on the watch to be played via headphones without requiring a smartphone.

attributes.name: NFC
attributes.description: A short-range wireless technology that triggers a transaction between the watch and another device, usually by bumping them together. On smartwatches, it’s most often used to initiate the pairing sequence with a new phone or tablet to authorize payments at a retailer’s pay terminal.

attributes.name: WiFi
attributes.description: A long-range wireless communication technology that enables a smartwatch to pair with a smartphone and with other devices within a home network or remote location via the Internet.

attributes.name: SpO2 sensor
attributes.description: An Sp02 blood oxygen sensor measures your blood oxygen level which should be between 95% - 100% for healthy individuals and provides insights into an important indicator of your overall wellness.

attributes.name: ECG
attributes.description: Can record your heartbeat and rhythm using the electrical heart sensor and then check the recording for atrial fibrillation, a form of irregular rhythm.

attributes.name: VO2 Max
attributes.description: VO2 max refers to how much oxygen your body can absorb and use during exercise. If you’re looking to improve your aerobic fitness, you might consider maximizing your VO2 max (sometimes called your oxygen uptake).

attributes.name: Blood pressure (claimed)
attributes.description: Manufacturer claims their smartwatch can measure blood pressure at-wrist. This is not tested.

attributes.name: Menstrual cycle tracking
attributes.description: A manual method of entering time-of-month data which can be tracked.

attributes.name: Menstrual cycle tracking with temperature
attributes.description: Menstrual cycle tracking with temperature uses a temperature sensor to notify that the menstrual cycle has begun.

attributes.name: Guided breathing
attributes.description: A coaching method used to guide your breathing in order to reduce stress and is associated with your general wellness.

attributes.name: Stress tracking
attributes.description: Stress tracking falls under (Wellness) which is based on various input from sensors for HRV, skin temperature, heart-rate and some others that indicate stress. Different manufacturer's use different algorithms to assess stress levels.

attributes.name: SWOLF
attributes.description: SWOLF is a score that measures your swimming efficiency, and a lower score is better. For pool swimming, the SWOLF score for a length is obtained by adding the number of strokes taken in the pool length, and the time it took to swim that length.

attributes.name: Heart rate variations (HRV)
attributes.description:
(HRV): High HRV is associated with healthy longevity and the side of the nervous system that promotes relaxation, digestion, sleep and recovery.
A low HRV reading is associated with stress, overtraining, inflammation and illness. Diabetes, coronary heart disease and high cholesterol are things commonly tied to having a low HRV as well.

attributes.name: Sleep tracking
attributes.description: Sleep tracking is the process of monitoring a person's sleep, most often by measuring inactivity and movement.

attributes.name: Alerts
attributes.description: Alerts you to incoming calls, texts, social network updates, or other notifications by using vibration at wrist or sound or visual.

attributes.name: Navigation
attributes.description: This is for any kind of map that is shown at-wrist on your watch, either a VISUAL map with streets or some others have only "Navigation" which uses waypoints but shows no visual "underlying" map but just a single route line with no background map.

attributes.name: Breadcrumb navigation
attributes.description: From the Hansel and Gretel fairy tale by the Brothers Grimm. When their father took them into the woods to abandon them, the children dropped crumbs of bread along the way to leave a trail back home. This is a method of finding your way back to the start of a route. It is very useful if you are lost.

attributes.name: Ambient sound level notification
attributes.description: This uses a microphone to detect ambient noise levels. This is not the same as headphone noise level protection.

attributes.name: Crash detection (claim)
attributes.description: Crash Detection uses sensors and algorithms that detect severe car crashes and automatically contact emergency services. This is not tested.

attributes.name: SOS emergency calling (claim)
attributes.description: Emergency SOS on some watches is enabled by pressing and holding a side button to quickly contact emergency services and provide them with your location. For a period of time, your emergency contacts will get updates when your location changes. This includes 911 calling. This is not tested - it is claimed.

attributes.name: Fall detection (claim)
attributes.description: Fall Detection or Incident detection is used if you’re at home or out adventuring, if a fall is detected and you’re unresponsive, a call to emergency services will be placed automatically.

attributes.name: Siren
attributes.description: One watch can provide an 86-decibel siren. If you get lost or injured and need to attract attention, an 86 dB siren can be heard up to 600 feet or 180 meters away.

attributes.description: Indicates features that increase a smartwatch's utility or capabilities. These include how many sensors it has, if it has cellular connectivity, can you make and receive calls at-wrist, does it have inactivity alerts, GPS tracking, and other useful features.

attributes.name: Health
attributes.description: A score of combined health-related features such as: health, safety, exercise/fitness, and wellness.

attributes.name: Step-count performance
attributes.description: How well did the smartwatch count our testers actual steps.

attributes.name: Heart-rate performance
attributes.description: How well did the smartwatch measure our testers actual heart rate.

attributes.name: Scratch test
attributes.description: Durability is a greater concern for smartwatches than for any other personal electronics device because, by design, they’re exposed to the elements and are vulnerable to any hazards that your arms encounter. We use the Mohs scale, which compares the scratch resistance of minerals relative to one another using 10 minerals of increasing hardness as reference points. It rates talc as 1 and goes all the way up to diamond at a 10 rating. Our score is a reflection on how well the smartwatch crystal performed on the Mohs test, as well as against other smartwatches in our Ratings.

attributes.name: Water resistance test
attributes.description: How resistant the watch is to submersion in water, as tested by subjecting the device to a water pressure equivalent to the depth the manufacturer claims the smartwatch can withstand.

attributes.name: Ease of interaction
attributes.description: An evaluation of the steps necessary to access core device functions and perform key tasks, such as accessing messages, calendars and alarms, and app notifications.

attributes.name: Readability in bright light
attributes.description: How easy it is to read the display (time, texts, etc.) under bright lighting conditions, such as in sunlight.

attributes.name: Readability in low light
attributes.description: How is easy it is to read the display (time, texts, etc.) in relative darkness, indoors or at night.

attributes.name: Ease of pairing
attributes.description: An assessment of the steps necessary for pairing the smartwatch with another device for the first time.

attributes.name: Crystal type
attributes.description: The material used to protect the display. Often it’s made of a mineral such as sapphire or quartz, or other materials such as glass or plastic.

attributes.name: Case material
attributes.description: Primary material used to manufacture the case, excluding the display.

attributes.name: Diameter
attributes.description: The diameter of the case, measured to nearest tenth of an inch.

attributes.name: Display size
attributes.description: Size of the active screen, to the nearest tenth of an inch.

attributes.name: Weight
attributes.description: Weight of watch in ounces.

attributes.name: Thickness
attributes.description: Thickness of the watch measured to the nearest tenth of an inch.

attributes.name: Cellular
attributes.description: Has the ability to connect to a cellular network without a smartphone.

attributes.name: Standalone GPS
attributes.description: Connects to GPS satellites to measure distance you moved during various exercises without having a smartphone present.

attributes.name: Standalone music
attributes.description: Allows music stored on the watch to be played via headphones without requiring a smartphone.

attributes.name: NFC
attributes.description: A short-range wireless technology that triggers a transaction between the watch and another device, usually by bumping them together. On smartwatches, it’s most often used to initiate the pairing sequence with a new phone or tablet to authorize payments at a retailer’s pay terminal.

attributes.name: WiFi
attributes.description: A long-range wireless communication technology that enables a smartwatch to pair with a smartphone and with other devices within a home network or remote location via the Internet.

attributes.name: SpO2 sensor
attributes.description: An Sp02 blood oxygen sensor measures your blood oxygen level which should be between 95% - 100% for healthy individuals and provides insights into an important indicator of your overall wellness.

attributes.name: ECG
attributes.description: Can record your heartbeat and rhythm using the electrical heart sensor and then check the recording for atrial fibrillation, a form of irregular rhythm.

attributes.name: VO2 Max
attributes.description: VO2 max refers to how much oxygen your body can absorb and use during exercise. If you’re looking to improve your aerobic fitness, you might consider maximizing your VO2 max (sometimes called your oxygen uptake).

attributes.name: Blood pressure (claimed)
attributes.description: Manufacturer claims their smartwatch can measure blood pressure at-wrist. This is not tested.

attributes.name: Menstrual cycle tracking
attributes.description: A manual method of entering time-of-month data which can be tracked.

attributes.name: Menstrual cycle tracking with temperature
attributes.description: Menstrual cycle tracking with temperature uses a temperature sensor to notify that the menstrual cycle has begun.

attributes.name: Guided breathing
attributes.description: A coaching method used to guide your breathing in order to reduce stress and is associated with your general wellness.

attributes.name: Stress tracking
attributes.description: Stress tracking falls under (Wellness) which is based on various input from sensors for HRV, skin temperature, heart-rate and some others that indicate stress. Different manufacturer's use different algorithms to assess stress levels.

attributes.name: SWOLF
attributes.description: SWOLF is a score that measures your swimming efficiency, and a lower score is better. For pool swimming, the SWOLF score for a length is obtained by adding the number of strokes taken in the pool length, and the time it took to swim that length.

attributes.name: Heart rate variations (HRV)
attributes.description:
(HRV): High HRV is associated with healthy longevity and the side of the nervous system that promotes relaxation, digestion, sleep and recovery.
A low HRV reading is associated with stress, overtraining, inflammation and illness. Diabetes, coronary heart disease and high cholesterol are things commonly tied to having a low HRV as well.

attributes.name: Sleep tracking
attributes.description: Sleep tracking is the process of monitoring a person's sleep, most often by measuring inactivity and movement.

attributes.name: Alerts
attributes.description: Alerts you to incoming calls, texts, social network updates, or other notifications by using vibration at wrist or sound or visual.

attributes.name: Navigation
attributes.description: This is for any kind of map that is shown at-wrist on your watch, either a VISUAL map with streets or some others have only "Navigation" which uses waypoints but shows no visual "underlying" map but just a single route line with no background map.

attributes.name: Breadcrumb navigation
attributes.description: From the Hansel and Gretel fairy tale by the Brothers Grimm. When their father took them into the woods to abandon them, the children dropped crumbs of bread along the way to leave a trail back home. This is a method of finding your way back to the start of a route. It is very useful if you are lost.

attributes.name: Ambient sound level notification
attributes.description: This uses a microphone to detect ambient noise levels. This is not the same as headphone noise level protection.

attributes.name: Crash detection (claim)
attributes.description: Crash Detection uses sensors and algorithms that detect severe car crashes and automatically contact emergency services. This is not tested.

attributes.name: SOS emergency calling (claim)
attributes.description: Emergency SOS on some watches is enabled by pressing and holding a side button to quickly contact emergency services and provide them with your location. For a period of time, your emergency contacts will get updates when your location changes. This includes 911 calling. This is not tested - it is claimed.

attributes.name: Fall detection (claim)
attributes.description: Fall Detection or Incident detection is used if you’re at home or out adventuring, if a fall is detected and you’re unresponsive, a call to emergency services will be placed automatically.

attributes.name: Siren
attributes.description: One watch can provide an 86-decibel siren. If you get lost or injured and need to attract attention, an 86 dB siren can be heard up to 600 feet or 180 meters away.

attributes.name: Low battery indicator
attributes.description: A low battery indicator is shown on the watch screen.

attributes.name: Always-on display capability
attributes.description: Some smartwatches have displays that are "Always-on" and some can be switched to "Always-on".

attributes.name: Touch screen
attributes.description: Indicates whether the watch can be controlled by touching its display.

attributes.name: Display type
attributes.description: Technology used by the display, such as OLED, AMOLED, Super AMOLED, LCD, or e-paper.

attributes.name: Heart-rate monitor
attributes.description: Indicates what type of heart-rate monitor is used, if at all. The two main types are active and stationary. Stationary heart-rate monitors measure your pulse only at intervals you choose, mostly at rest. Active heart-rate monitors measure your pulse continuously, or automatically at variable intervals.

attributes.name: Battery life
attributes.description: Claimed number days, often a range, manufacturer says the watch will function on a charge.

attributes.name: Phone compatibility
attributes.description: Indicates which phones, either specific models or the operating system they use that works with the watch.

attributes.name: Depth and duration
attributes.description: How resistant the watch is to submersion in water, as tested by subjecting the device to a water pressure equivalent to the depth the manufacturer claims the smartwatch can withstand.

expertReview.bottomLine: This high chair has some good features, like the magnetic tray attachment. But it doesn't fold and can be awkward to move, as there is no good place to hold onto to pick it up.  The seat pad is wipe clean only.
expertReview.highs: Tray has a magnetic attachment, making it easy to attach and adjust. Tray insert is dishwasher safe. Height adjustable. Backrest reclines.
expertReview.lows: Chair does not fold. Seat pad is wipe clean only (not machine washable).

attributes.name: Safety
attributes.description: Safety for each high chair was assessed by our testing, which is based on the federal safety standard, which references ASTM F404-21.  Tests include evaluations of the restraint system, stability of the high chair, and static load assessments, as well as other tests.

attributes.name: Ease of use
attributes.description: Ease of use is based on a trained panel's assessments of harness adjustment and use, folding and unfolding, removing and replacing the tray and tray insert (if any), adjusting seat back and height where applicable, removing and replacing the seat cover.

attributes.name: Ease of cleaning
attributes.description: Ease of cleaning reflects how easy or difficult it was to clean the high chair, taking into account the configuration and materials used in the chair frame, seat, seat pad, tray and tray insert, if any.   Easiest-to-clean surfaces should be smooth with minimal seams or crevices to collect gunk.  Seat pads, if present,  should be machine washable and/or easy to clean effectively with a damp cloth or sponge.

attributes.name: Weight
attributes.description: Weight is the weight of the chair (with tray in place) in pounds.

attributes.name: Footprint
attributes.description: Footprint is the amount of floor space, in square inches, that the chair takes up while in use.  Small is 575 square inches or less. Medium is 576 to 675 square inches. Large is 676 square inches and up.

attributes.name: Folds for storage
attributes.description: Whether or not the high chair folds for storage (many do not).

attributes.name: Harness type
attributes.description: Harness type is 5-point, incorporating shoulder as well as waist and crotch straps - which we strongly recommend - or 3-point.  Some harnesses convert from 5-point to 3-point by removing the shoulder straps.  We suggest using the 5-point configuration, unless you're very confident that your child will stay put and not try to wiggle out of the harness.

attributes.name: One-hand tray removal
attributes.description: Being able to remove the high chair tray easily, with one hand, is a great feature.  It allows you to keep the other hand free to tend to your baby.

attributes.name: Wheels and casters
attributes.description: Whether the high chair has wheels or casters to aid in moving the chair around.

attributes.name: Multiple recline positions
attributes.description: Whether the high chair's seat back is able to be reclined in one or more positions.

attributes.name: Height adjusts
attributes.description: Whether or not the high chair has a height adjustment feature.

attributes.name: How to clean seat pad
attributes.description: The manufacturer's instructions for cleaning the high chair's seat pad.  (Most high chair frames are cleaned simply by wiping with a mild cleaning solution and sponge or cloth.)  Some seat pads are machine washable, others are hand washable, and some just wipe-clean with the aforementioned mild cleaning solution and cloth.

attributes.name: Converts to booster seat
attributes.description: With some models, you can just detach the high chair seat from the frame, and voila! a booster seat. Just strap the booster securely to a dining chair, to let your little one sit with the family at the table. (Other high chairs may require some disassembly or futzing, but it's usually a fairly easy process.)

attributes.name: Converts to toddler/youth chair
attributes.description: Some high chairs can be converted to toddler or "youth" chairs.  The weight limit for each chair indicates how large a child - or, for some models, a young adult - can be accommodated.

expertReview.summary: The 4moms MamaRoo Sleep Bassinet is part of the Bassinets test program at Consumer Reports. In our lab tests, Bassinet models like the MamaRoo Sleep are rated on multiple criteria, such as those listed below. Convenience takes into account the features that make a bassinet easier to use, such as portability, ease of accessing the baby, adjustability of the bassinet's frame height, onboard storage for diapers or extra bassinet sheets, automatic soothing, motion or sound features, and others. Ease of assembly scoring takes into account the number of parts, the number of steps and the number of actions in each step.
expertReview.bottomLine: This smart bassinet from 4moms offers motion and sound features to help soothe your baby, controllable by either a phone app or the console on the unit. You can choose from several types of motion and sounds, and also adjust the intensity of both. Frame height is adjustable.
expertReview.highs: This smart bassinet, with motion and sound features to help soothe baby, can be controlled with buttons on its console, or with an app. Either method allows parents to select motion and sound type and intensity. Frame height is adjustable, using (included) leg extenders. Bassinet sheet is machine washable.
expertReview.lows: App limits motion and sound to 4 hours.

attributes.name: Convenience
attributes.description: Convenience assessment rates features that make the bassinet easier to use, including portability, whether the bassinet folds for storage, whether the frame height is adjustable (to match its height to the parents' bed or a chair), ease of accessing the baby, onboard storage for diapers, wipes, etc., motion and sound features, automatic soothing of a crying baby, and the ease of using an app, if applicable.

attributes.name: Ease of assembly
attributes.description: Ease of assembly takes into account the number of parts, the number of steps to assemble, and the number of actions required in each step.

attributes.name: Weight
attributes.description: The weight of the bassinet, to the nearest pound.

attributes.name: WiFi enabled
attributes.description: Whether or not the unit can connect via WiFi to a cell phone app, allowing the user to control the bassinet remotely.

attributes.name: Lifespan
attributes.description: The lifespan of a bassinet is the point at which the baby should stop using the bassinet, as  determined by cutoffs set by its manufacturer.  It may be a developmental milestone, such as the baby being able to push up on hands and knees, a weight limit, or an age limit.  These limits are intended to prevent a baby from falling out of the bassinet.
attributes.value: once child begins to pull up, push up or sit unassisted, regardless of age or weight. max weight 25lbs. max age 6 months

attributes.name: Frame height adjusts
attributes.description: Whether the bassinet's frame can be raised or lowered to match, for example, the height of the parent's bed.

attributes.name: Motion feature
attributes.description: Whether or not the bassinet has a motion feature, where it moves in fixed patterns to soothe a baby to sleep.

attributes.name: Sound feature
attributes.description: Whether or not the bassinet has the ability to play sounds or music.

attributes.name: Automated soothing
attributes.description: Bassinet responds automatically to a baby's cries with motion and sound; the parent can set parameters for both in the bassinet's app.

attributes.name: Storage
attributes.description: Whether or not the bassinet has onboard storage for diapers, sleep sacks, swaddles and the like.

attributes.name: Wheels
attributes.description: Whether or not the bassinet has wheels for easier transport.   Some wheels are lockable.  Some are retractable, so the bassinet can rock.

expertReview.bottomLine: Not a traditional ranch style dressing. Oily and very thick dressing that has a salty, nutty taste with a very big dill flavor. Dried spices give it a grainy mouthfeel. Might be better as a dip than dressing.

attributes.name: Nutrition score
attributes.description: Nutrition score is based on calories, total fat, saturated fat, sodium, and added sugars per serving. Certain added ingredients may also impact score. Extra weighting may be given to nutrients that are influential, either positive or negative, to the food category.

attributes.name: Sensory score
attributes.description: Sensory score is based on flavor and texture attributes measured by trained tasters.

attributes.name: USDA organic
attributes.description: USDA Organic as listed on product package.

attributes.name: Calories
attributes.description: Calories pe 2 tablespoons as listed on product label.

attributes.name: Total fat
attributes.description: Total fat (g) per 2 tablespoons as listed on product label.

attributes.name: Saturated fat
attributes.description: Total saturated fat per 2 Tablespoons as listed on product label.

attributes.name: Carbohydrates
attributes.description: Total carbohydrates per 2 Tablespoons as listed on the product label.

attributes.name: Added sugars
attributes.description: Added sugars (g) per 2 Tablespoons as listed on product label.

attributes.name: Sodium
attributes.description: Sodium (mg) per 2 Tablespoons as listed on product label.

attributes.name: Package size
attributes.description: As listed on product label.

attributes.name: Price per serving
attributes.description: Based on the approximate number of two tablespoon servings on the package.

expertReview.summary: This arm monitor has an irregular heartbeat detector, a BP risk category indicator, a one-size-fits-most cuff and data averaging function. It allows multiple users to store readings separately and can be paired to a smart device.
expertReview.bottomLine: This device comes with a flexible nylon cuff (9 - 14.6). It may be difficult for some users to wrap the cuff around their own arm and align the artery marker. Although the cuff is not molded, the nylon is stiff. The numbers on the display are not as large as some of the other arm monitors, but testers did not find them difficult to read. There is no initial date/time set up for the meter, you sync it to a smart device via Bluetooth and can transfer the readings, once the readings are synced to the smart device, there is a time/date stamp on each reading. A smart device is not required to use this monitor because it has a stand-alone display but the readings on the display will not show a time/date stamp. The app allows you to view the results in daily, weekly and monthly average graphs. You can also email or text message results from the app. If your expected systolic pressure exceeds 230 mmHg, you must press and hold the start button until a number 30 to 40 mmHg higher than the expected pressure appears. A larger cuff (12.2 - 17.7 inches) may be purchased separately.
expertReview.highs:
• Has an irregular heartbeat detector.
  • Has a BP risk category indicator.
  • Has a one-size-fits-most cuff.
  • Allows multiple users to store readings separately.
  • Can download memory.
  • Data averaging function.
  • Very Good for comfort.
  • Directions for how to use on cuff.
expertReview.lows: • Users must buy different sized cuffs separately if they have very large arms.

expertReview.summary: This wrist monitor has an irregular heartbeat detector, a BP risk category indicator and allows multiple users to store readings separately. It includes a one-size-fits-most cuff and indicates when the user's wrist is at heart level. It also has the ability to sync it to the A&D Connect app where data can be averaged and graphed.
expertReview.bottomLine: The A&D UB-1100 wrist monitor has a one-size-fits-most (5.3 to 8.5 inches) soft cuff that testers found was easy to wrap around their own wrists. The velcro has a strong hold but is not difficult to unfasten. Up and down arrows on the display direct you to raise or lower your wrist for correct positioning prior to taking a reading. An "OK" symbol appears when the wrist is in the correct position but the monitor will start even if you are not in the correct position. This model can be used as a stand-alone or you can sync it to the A&D Connect app (iOS and Android) to keep track of your readings with graphs and helps chart your progress and share results with your physician. In addition to blood pressure, the app also allows you to monitor activity and sleep patterns. A few monitor caveats: After the reading is complete, the systolic, diastolic and heart rate readings scroll on the screen individually so you may have to wait to see your entire reading (it scrolls through 10x), testers found this unit noisier than most and you have to ensure that the unit is charged via micro USB prior to using.

  • Has a BP risk category indicator.
  • Allows multiple users to store readings separately.
  • Includes two cuff sizes or a one-size-fits-most cuff.
  • Indicates when the user's wrist is at heart level.
  • Can download memory.
  • Excellent for comfort.
  • Directions for how to use on cuff.
expertReview.lows: • This model received a fair accuracy score.

expertReview.summary: This pressure washer from A-ipower is gas-powered and claims 2700 psi max with 2.3 gpm. It comes with 3 nozzle tips, solid wheels, and the cleaning tip is replaceable. It weighs 60 lbs.
expertReview.highs:
• Very effective at removing stains.
  • Effective at power.
  • High flow (GPM).
  • Easy to operate its controls, move it, store it.
  • Has low oil shut off.
  • Replaceable nozzle tips.
expertReview.lows:
• Has manual trigger lock.
  • Small spray angle.
  • Relatively loud.
  • Noisy when close to unit.
  • Hose shorter than most.
expertReview.review:
• Easy to move and transport.
  • Requires storage of gasoline or using special 240 volt outlet (electric only).
  • Easy hose storage.
  • Wand very easy to remove and use.
  • Easy to use and read on-off switch.

attributes.name: Cleaning
attributes.description: Versatility and efficiency in cleaning a range of surfaces. The better performers have multiple spray patterns that can cover various cleaning chores, from light, superficial cleaning to deep cleaning of concrete, decking, and other hard-to-clean surfaces.

attributes.name: Power
attributes.description: A combination of pressure, measured in pounds per square inch (psi), and flow, measured in gallons per minute (gpm). Higher pressure results in better cleaning of a given surface; coupled with a higher flow as well, you'll get the job done the fastest.

attributes.name: Noise
attributes.description: A combination of measurements, based on dBA, reflecting the proximity of the operator to the pressure washer. While our Noise score averages measurements taken close by the machine and at the end of the hose's typical reach, we strongly recommend hearing protection for working close by a gas-powered model in particular.

attributes.name: Ease of use
attributes.description: Reflects how easy it is to operate, including transport, power (adding fuel or plugging in), storage (hose and cord wrapping), and protection (from thermal and low-oil conditions). This score also includes helpful features and water inlet and outlet, nozzle, and wand connections.

attributes.name: Weight
attributes.description: Weight of the pressure washer, with all accessories, to the nearest ½ pound. For gas models, the weight includes a full tank of fuel.

attributes.name: Pressure range
attributes.description: The maximum claimed water pressure at the nozzle, in pounds per square inch. Higher pressures can typically provide more cleaning power at wider nozzle angles, letting you complete the job more quickly.

attributes.name: Flow rate
attributes.description: The claimed amount of water being used, in gallons per minute (gpm). For reference, a garden hose without a nozzle can flow anywhere from 6 to 10 (or more) gallons a minute depending on the hose diameter and water pressure.

attributes.name: Engine size
attributes.description: For pressure washers with gasoline-powered engines, it's the engine displacement measured in cubic centimeters (cc). Electric motors, however, are represented by amps and battery units by the overall voltage of the system.

attributes.name: Cord length
attributes.description: For electric models, the length of the cord, in feet. All models provide similar cord lengths, long enough to reduce the need for extension cords.

attributes.name: Hose
attributes.description: The length of the high-pressure hose, in feet. Longer lengths allow further reach without the need to move the main unit.

attributes.name: Handle
attributes.description: Distance in inches from the hose connection on the wand to the nozzle. Longer wands allow greater reach and could limit the splashback of water and debris. (Always wear goggles when power-washing.)

attributes.name: Temperature range
attributes.description: The maximum recommended temperature of the incoming water. Some models allow warmer incoming water, though they state that water isn't hot enough for steam-cleaning.

attributes.name: Warranty
attributes.description: How long the pressure washer is covered by its manufacturer for defects or repairs.

attributes.name: Pump protection
attributes.description: For gas models, leaving the unit running without spraying water can overheat and damage the pump. Models with a thermal-pump protection, however, can reduce the risk. For electric models, extended use or the use of an improper extension cord can cause the motor to overheat. Models that claim to have thermal motor protection will shut the motor in those circumstances to prevent damage.

attributes.name: Turbo
attributes.description: Models with this feature, typically electric models, come with a special turbo or spin nozzle that allows for quicker cleaning with less pressure.

attributes.name: Wheels
attributes.description: Whether the unit has wheels. Most electric models are light and use solid-plastic wheels appropriate for that application. Gas-powered models typically have larger wheels that are solid or have pneumatic-rubber tires. Pneumatic tires can provide extra shock absorption, though they also lose air over time.

attributes.name: Storage
attributes.description: Manufacturer recommendations on how to store the unit between uses and to protect it under freezing conditions. Many require the use of some form of antifreeze; manufacturers use different brand names such as Pump Saver and Pump Protector. Alternatively, the units can be stored indoors during the winter.

attributes.name: Soap nozzle
attributes.description: A soap nozzle, sometimes called a detergent nozzle, allows the pressure washer to dispense soap or detergent under low pressure.

attributes.name: Hose storage
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pressure washer has the preferred hose reel, a way to manually wrap the hose, or no ability to store the hose.

attributes.name: Nozzle type
attributes.description: Some units come with a single adjustable powerhead that provides infinitely variable spray angles from its minimum to its maximum. Others have replaceable nozzles that provide exact spray angles, typically from 0 degrees for a strong pinpoint stream to 40 degrees for a wide pattern, for quick, general cleaning.

attributes.name: Number of nozzles
attributes.description: Total number of nozzles included with the unit.

attributes.name: Soap/detergent dispenser
attributes.description: Most pressure washers can apply soap or detergent under low pressure. The easiest method is through an on-board tank where the soap or detergent can be stored. Another method includes the use of a bottle that is filled with the soap or detergent and attached to the end of the wand, making it heavier. The most basic method just includes a hose; for these, you need to figure out how to secure the bottle.

attributes.name: Trigger safety lock-out
attributes.description: All pressure washer wands have a way to prevent accidental engagement of the trigger. Some models require a manual process; others are done automatically. The latter can add an extra level of safety but can be less convenient to use.

reliability.infoText: Predicted brand reliability ratings are based on estimated problem rates for newly purchased gas powered pressure washers, not covered by an extended warranty or service contract, within the first three years of ownership.

ownerSatisfaction.infoText: Owner satisfaction ratings are based on the proportion of members who are extremely likely to recommend their gas powered pressure washers brand to their friends and family.

expertReview.summary:
This Ipower Portable (5000 - 7000) generator is gasoline-powered and is rated for 6000 watts. It has:
  • fuel shutoff
  • low-oil shutoff
  • 5 power outlets
expertReview.highs:
• Delivered more than enough wattage to power our test appliances and handled surges very well.
  • Provided clean power with consistent voltage.
  • Easy to start and has some helpful features.
  • Has fuel shutoff.
  • Includes low-oil shutoff, which protects the engine from overheating if the oil level dips too low.
  • Also displays a low oil light to tell you why it shut down.
expertReview.lows: • Fairly noisy from a distance of 23 feet; we recommend hearing protection for standing close.

attributes.name: Power delivery
attributes.description: How much wattage models delivered and how well they handled surges in power demand over various loads.

attributes.name: Power quality
attributes.description: A generator's ability to deliver power smoothly, with consistent voltage.

attributes.name: Noise
attributes.description: Measured at 23 and 50 feet from the generator. We recommend hearing protection for standing close by the unit while it's running.

attributes.name: Ease of use
attributes.description: Includes starting, transport (for portables), and helpful features such as fuel shutoff.

attributes.name: CO safety technology
attributes.description: The presence and responsiveness of built-in CO-sensing technology to automatically shut the generator off in an enclosed space before CO builds up to dangerous levels.

attributes.name: Run time range
attributes.description: Our average of how long a generator ran, over various loads, on a full tank of gasoline or diesel fuel, a 20-pound tank for propane-based portables, or a 250-gallon propane tank for stationary models.

attributes.name: Claimed output
attributes.description: Maximum wattage for continuous operation, as per the manufacturer.

attributes.name: 120/240V
attributes.description: Whether or not the generator offers a 120/240V plug that can power appliances that require a 240V power source.

attributes.name: Fuel type
attributes.description: Gasoline, diesel fuel, propane, or (stationary models only) natural gas.

attributes.name: Weight
attributes.description: The generator’s weight, to the nearest pound, when fully fueled. (Propane tanks are separate, and natural-gas models are fueled externally.) Weight for stationary models, which stay where installed, is "NA," for not applicable.

attributes.name: Fuel shutoff
attributes.description: Lets you draw gas from the fuel system to keep it from leaking, or from fouling parts if it degrades during storage.

attributes.name: Low-oil shutoff
attributes.description: Turns off the engine if the oil level is low, preventing damage.

attributes.name: Electric start
attributes.description: Lets you start the engine with a switch or pushbutton rather than a pull cord.

attributes.name: Fuel gauge
attributes.description: Indicates how much fuel is in a portable generator's tank.

attributes.name: Hour meter
attributes.description: An indicator of how long you have run the generator since your last oil change, helpful for scheduling maintenance.

attributes.name: Low-oil shutoff has indicator light
attributes.description: When the generator has shut off due to low oil, indicates why.

attributes.name: Electric-start battery included
attributes.description: Only some generators with this feature include the necessary battery, which must otherwise be purchased separately (usually about $50).

attributes.name: Wheels
attributes.description: Whether wheels (portable generators only) come standard with the unit or must be purchased separately.

attributes.name: Fuel capacity
attributes.description: For portable units, how many gallons of gasoline or diesel fuel the tank can hold. Tanks for propane-powered portables are the 20-lb. size. Stationary models are fueled externally from a fixed propane or natural-gas tank.

attributes.name: No. of power outlets
attributes.description: How many appliances you can plug directly into the generator (portable units only). We strongly recommend you use a transfer switch for long-term needs.

expertReview.summary: The Abode Cam 2 has 1080p video resolution, has Very Good 121 degree field of view, can be used indoors or outdoors, works with Amazon Alexa, and works with Google Assistant.
expertReview.bottomLine: The Abode Cam 2 has 1080p video resolution. Overall this model has Very Good video with higher quality detail than many, Very Good data security offering a high level of protection from your data being hacked or stolen, responds quickly to be able to speak with a visitor. It has Alexa, Google Home, and two-way audio communication.
expertReview.highs:
• Very Good job for video quality
  • Very Good response time (a score based on elapsed time between motion occuring within the cameras field of view and the ability to speak to the visitor)
  • Very Good 121 degree field of view
  • Person alerts (eliminates extra false motion alerts)
  • Monitoring/Activity zones (motion in parts of the field of view can be ignored or prioritized)
  • Two-way audio communication (cameras can be placed at the front door and other locations to allow two-way talking)
expertReview.lows:
• Lacks rechargeable batteries so cameras have to be hardwired for power
  • Lacks magnetic mount (limits mobile placement of cameras)

expertReview.summary: A 15.6-inch laptop tested with Windows 11 Home, an AMD Ryzen 5 7520U 2.8GHz processor, 8GB of memory, AMD Radeon graphics, a touchscreen, and a 512GB solid-state drive.
expertReview.bottomLine: The Acer Aspire 3 A315-24PT-R90Z is a 15.6-inch laptop, and its performance speeds are good for complex productivity for school and office work. Its battery life is average for both web browsing at 11 hours and video playback at 6 hours and should last you through a workday. This laptop is rated Excellent for ergonomic design.
expertReview.highs:
• Touchscreen provides a convenient way to navigate and interact
• At 3.8 lbs, this laptop is lighter than typical laptops of this size category
• Comes with a large amount of total storage space
• Comes with a fast, more efficient solid-state drive
expertReview.lows:
• No optical drive
• Lacks a memory card reader
expertReview.description:
The Acer Aspire 3 A315-24PT-R90Z is a 15.6-inch laptop with a screen resolution of 1920 x 1080. It has 8GB of memory and a 512GB solid-state drive. It has an AMD Ryzen 5 7520U 2.8GHz processor and an integrated AMD Radeon. It lacks an optical drive for burning CDs or DVDs. It was tested with Windows 11 Home installed.

It has a touch screen, 2 full-size, 1 type-C USB ports built-in on the laptop. Video outputs include: an HDMI full-size port, supporting DisplayPort over USB-C. It supports WiFi 5 (802.11ac), so it's compatible with high-speed routers. It also supports WiFi 6 (802.11ax), which provides faster and more dependable High Efficiency Wireless, but you'll need a compatible router to see the faster speeds. It has Bluetooth 5.2 built-in. It has a 0.9MP webcam for video conferencing. Our tested sample came bundled with a carrying sleeve.

The Acer Aspire 3 A315-24PT-R90Z measures 14.3 inches wide by 9.4 inches deep by 1 inches high, and it weighs 3.8 lbs. It's backed by a 12-month warranty, with 12 months of free tech support over telephone.
expertReview.review:
Performance: Overall this laptop's performance was only Fair, well below that of many models but still good enough for routine tasks like email, word processing and web browsing. Compared to other tested laptops, its speed was adequate for common tasks such as web browsing, video conferencing, and application startup. Performance was okay but on the slow side when composing documents, working on data spreadsheets, and running other productivity tasks, and it was so slow that it was difficult to manipulate images, edit videos, and calculate simulations.

Portability: This laptop is a Very Good choice for traveling. Battery life lasted 11 hours in a light load of web browsing tests, and 6 hours in a heavier load of 4K video playback tests. Results could get you through a typical workday, under a workload of mixed use. At 3.8 lbs, this laptop is lightweight for a laptop of this size category.

Ergonomics: The laptop features, such as its keyboard, touchpad, and labeling were well-designed, making it comfortable and convenient to use. The keyboard has large keys and was comfortably sized. Its high contrast letters were easy to read. There's a dedicated number pad for faster data entry. The power button was well labeled and conveniently located. Friction on the touchscreen may prevent fast swiping, and fingerprints may take some effort to clean off.

Display: The display quality was Very Good overall. Colors were in the ballpark, though not completely accurate. The display was anti-reflective, so there was little or no glare when viewing in a brightly lit room or outdoors. The display has a wide viewing angle, especially important if more than one person needs to see the screen at a time, say, for a video or presentation. Its display produces a smaller array of colors than on most other tested laptops.

Useful features and attributes on this model include: Laptop has a touchscreen. The 512GB solid-state drive uses less power and accesses data more quickly than conventional hard-disk drives. You can connect common external devices such as hard drives and Blu-ray burners using USB 3.2 Gen 2 (10 Gbps) for maximum performance. This laptop has a full-size HDMI port and supports DisplayPort over USB-C for connecting to an HDTV or monitor.

Downsides: There's no optical drive like a CD or DVD reader, so you'll have to buy an external drive if you need one. There is no memory-card reader, so you'll need to buy an external reader or connect your digital camera directly to this laptop to transfer photos.

attributes.name: Portability
attributes.description: Based on battery life under a mix of light and heavy tasks, size, and weight including the keyboard dock for detachable laptops.

attributes.name: Performance
attributes.description: Based on performance while running productivity applications, multimedia applications, web browsing, and 3D games.

attributes.name: Display
attributes.description: Covers display size, clarity, color, contrast, brightness, and glare.

attributes.name: Ergonomics
attributes.description: Represents the quality of the keyboard and pointing device, and accessibility of features.

attributes.name: Versatility
attributes.description: Includes hardware such as memory-card slots and AV connections, software such as security programs, and tech support and warranty provisions.

attributes.name: Battery Life - web
attributes.description: The time it takes to deplete a fully charged battery while the laptop loads a sequence of web pages over WiFi. Bluetooth and 3G/4G are disabled and the screen is set to a specific brightness that's usable indoors or outdoors.

attributes.name: Battery Life - video
attributes.description: The time it takes to deplete a fully charged battery while the laptop loops a 4K video. Bluetooth and 3G/4G are disabled and the screen is set to a specific brightness that's usable indoors or outdoors.

attributes.name: Weight
attributes.description: The weight of the laptop as you would carry it around, including the battery but without the power adapter or a removable CD/DVD drive. Detachable laptops include the weight of the keyboard.

attributes.name: OS
attributes.description: The operating system that was installed on the computer at the time it was tested. The operating system is the software that controls the basic operation of the computer. Common examples are Windows and Mac OS. The operating system determines the "look and feel" of the PC.

attributes.name: Touch screen
attributes.description: Denotes presence of a touchscreen, which is sensitive to finger contact, letting you select and move screen objects, launch programs, choose from menus, scroll through photo libraries, and the like. Some touchscreens have "multi-touch", letting you use more than one finger to resize and rotate objects.

attributes.name: 2-in-1
attributes.description: Laptop is able to convert by folding, rotating, or spinning into a tablet form factor or the screen detaches from the keyboard so you carry it as a tablet. "C" denotes convertible, "D" denotes detachable and "-" denotes a standard clamshell laptop.

attributes.name: Display size
attributes.description: The diagonal measure of the LCD (Liquid Crystal Display) screen.

attributes.name: Operating system (as tested)
attributes.description: The operating system that was installed on the computer at the time it was tested. The operating system is the software that controls the basic operation of the computer. Common examples are Windows and Mac OS. The operating system determines the "look and feel" of the PC.

attributes.name: Processor brand
attributes.description: Also known as the CPU (Central Processing Unit), the processor is responsible for running commands and handling data. Processors come in different speeds and may have two or more cores (ex. dual-core), which let you more quickly process multiple complex tasks. This is the brand, or manufacturer, of the processor.

attributes.name: Processor model name
attributes.description: Also known as the CPU (Central Processing Unit), the processor is responsible for running commands and handling data. Processors come in different speeds and may have two or more cores (ex. dual-core), which let you more quickly process multiple complex tasks. This is the listed model name and speed for the processor.

attributes.name: Memory
attributes.description: Also known as RAM, memory is a temporary storage area for data. Its size is an important factor for performance. We recommend at least 4GB of memory, or 8GB if you plan to run several large applications at the same time.

attributes.name: Storage
attributes.description: The amount of storage, a permanent area for the operating system, programs and data such as documents, music, and media files. Storage can be a hard drive, an SSD (solid state drive), or hybrid drive.

attributes.name: Video memory
attributes.description: The amount of dedicated memory built into a graphics adapter. Most models have integrated graphics, which have no dedicated memory but are still suitable for most applications, including photo editing and watching movies. Others have discrete graphic adapters, which typically have 1 GB or more of dedicated video memory, to deliver smoother and more realistic graphics for 3D games.

attributes.name: Native resolution
attributes.description: The number of picture elements ("pixels") across the horizontal and vertical dimension of the screen. The higher the resolution within a given size screen, the finer the detail that can be displayed. No scaling is needed to view a picture or movie of this size, or to match the display resolution with the native resolution, sometimes called Default or Recommended.

attributes.name: Video adapter
attributes.description: Also known as the video card, the video adapter processes all the data that you see on your screen. They come in different speeds and may be integrated (most common, but is slower and uses up memory) or discrete (which is faster and has its own dedicated memory). If you will not be playing complex 3D games, any integrated graphics adapter will do. Otherwise, buy a discrete graphics adapter with a graphics processor from ATI or Nvidia with at least 256 MB of memory.

attributes.name: Optical drive
attributes.description: The optical drive reads and/or writes to CDs and DVDs. Most PCs come equipped with a DVD-RW, also known as a DVD burner, which lets you read and write to DVDs. Some models come with Blu-Ray drives, which let you play high-definition movies.

attributes.name: Height
attributes.description: The height from the table, or thickness, of the computer while closed. This includes the keyboard dock on detachable laptops.

attributes.name: Depth
attributes.description: The depth, from the front edge to the back hinge, of the computer while closed. This includes the keyboard dock for detachable laptops.

attributes.name: Width
attributes.description: The width of the computer while closed. This includes the keyboard dock of detachable laptops.

attributes.name: Thin and light
attributes.description: Based on weight and thickness. This includes laptops that may be labeled "Ultrabook," "Sleekbook," "Thin and light," and "Ultrathin," among other terms.

attributes.name: Warranty length
attributes.description: The length in months of the manufacturer's standard warranty.

attributes.name: Tech support length
attributes.description: The length in months of the manufacturer's free technical support by telephone.

attributes.name: Battery capacity
attributes.description: The total energy contained in the battery, expressed in Watt-hours. A larger capacity battery will deliver longer battery life, but will add weight and sometimes will extend beyond the edge of the laptop.

attributes.name: Comes in S Mode
attributes.description: Windows computers that come in S Mode can only run apps from the Microsoft Store. This is one way to ensure system security and stability. They can be switched out of S Mode for free, allowing them to run third-party applications. We test computers switched out of S Mode.

attributes.name: Suitable for gaming
attributes.description: All systems can play casual games such as solitaire and Angry Birds. Systems designated as suitable for gaming are more powerful and can play modern mainstream and intensive 3D video games with a frame rate and visual effects that does not make the game stop or stutter.

attributes.name: Blu-ray or DVD
attributes.description: Has either a Blu-Ray drive (B), which lets you watch Blu-Ray movies and read/write to CDs and DVDs, or a DVD drive (D), which lets you read/write to CDs and DVDs. Some computers have no optical drive installed (—).

attributes.name: Memory-card reader
attributes.description: At least one flash memory-card slot (CF, SD, XD, MS, etc.)

attributes.name: Facial recognition
attributes.description: Webcam can be set to scan your face for secure log-in.

attributes.name: Fingerprint reader
attributes.description: A biometric fingerprint reader for logging into your PC.

attributes.name: WiFi type
attributes.description: The type of built-in 802.11 wireless networking supported. Computers with 802.11n also support 802.11g routers. Some models with 802.11n also support the 5GHz "high band," a standard suitable for apartments and other crowded areas.

attributes.name: Thunderbolt port
attributes.description: Has a Thunderbolt port for connecting peripherals such as an external hard drive. This includes ports that may be on the keyboard dock of detachable laptops. Thunderbolt is a high-speed port that can connect to DVI, HDMI and VGA through the use of adapters. Thunderbolt 3 is the newest version that supports faster speeds.

attributes.name: Digital video out
attributes.description: Has an HDMI, DisplayPort, or Thunderbolt video output for sending a digital video signal to a computer monitor or HDTV.

attributes.name: Number of USB ports
attributes.description: Number of USB ports for printers, flash drives, or other peripherals. This includes ports that may be on the keyboard dock of detachable laptops.

attributes.name: Gigabit Ethernet
attributes.description: Support for 1,000 Mb/s networking.

attributes.name: HDMI output
attributes.description: An HDMI out port for sending a digital video/audio signal to a computer monitor or HDTV.

reliability.infoText: Predicted brand reliability ratings are based on estimated problem rates for newly purchased laptops, by the end of the 3rd year of ownership.

ownerSatisfaction.infoText: Owner satisfaction ratings are based on the proportion of members who are extremely likely to recommend their laptop to their friends and family.

expertReview.summary: A 15.6-inch laptop that came installed with Windows 10 Home in S Mode, but was tested with Windows 10 Home, an Intel Core i3-1115G4 3GHz processor, 4GB of memory, Intel UHD Graphics graphics, and a 128GB solid-state drive.
expertReview.bottomLine: The Acer Aspire 5 A515-56-363A 15-inch laptop with a HD IPS display has performance speeds that are Very Good for complex productivity work but may notice a slowdown during more demanding video games or graphical tasks. Its battery life is above the mid-range for its size category in web browsing test. Its display produces a smaller array of colors than other similar size tested models.
expertReview.highs:
• At 3.7 lbs, this laptop is lighter than typical laptops of this size category
• Comes with a fast, more efficient solid-state drive
expertReview.lows:
• Compared to typical hard drives, this solid-state drive provides less storage space
• No optical drive
• Lacks a memory card reader
expertReview.description:
The Acer Aspire 5 A515-56-363A is a 15.6-inch laptop with a screen resolution of 1920 x 1080. It has 4GB of memory and a 128GB solid-state drive. It has an Intel Core i3-1115G4 3GHz processor and an integrated Intel UHD Graphics. It lacks an optical drive for burning CDs or DVDs. It was tested with Windows 10 Home, which is available with a free upgrade; it was originally installed with Windows 10 Home in S Mode, which limits programs to those from the Microsoft Store.

It has 3 full-size, 1 type-C USB ports built-in on the laptop. Video outputs include: an HDMI full-size port. It supports WiFi 5 (802.11ac), so it's compatible with high-speed routers. It also supports WiFi 6 (802.11ax), which provides faster and more dependable High Efficiency Wireless, but you'll need a compatible router to see the faster speeds. Gigabit ethernet is built-in on the laptop. It has Bluetooth 5.0 built-in. It has a 0.9MP webcam for video conferencing.

The Acer Aspire 5 A515-56-363A measures 14.3 inches wide by 9.6 inches deep by 0.9 inches high, and it weighs 3.7 lbs. It's backed by a 12-month warranty, with 12 months of free tech support over telephone.
expertReview.review:
Performance: Overall this laptop's performance was only Fair, well below that of many models but still good enough for routine tasks like email, word processing and web browsing. Compared to other tested laptops, it was fast for common tasks such as web browsing and video conferencing. Applications start up quickly. Performance was okay for light productivity but for some more demanding tasks may be very slow, particularly when calculating large data spreadsheets or using images in multiple documents, and it was so slow that it was difficult to manipulate images, edit videos, and calculate simulations.

Portability: This laptop is a Very Good choice for traveling. Battery life lasted 10.5 hours in a light load of web browsing tests, and 5.5 hours in a heavier load of 4K video playback tests. Results could get you through a typical workday, under a workload of mixed use. At 3.7 lbs, this laptop is lightweight for a laptop of this size category.

Ergonomics: Some features of the keyboard, touchpad, and labeling, were well-designed, and were comfortable or convenient to use. The keyboard has large keys and was comfortably sized. Its high contrast letters were easy to read, and the backlighting can be useful in dark rooms. There's a dedicated number pad for faster data entry. The power button was well labeled and conveniently located.

Display: The display quality was Very Good overall. Colors were not reproduced as accurately as on better displays. The display was anti-reflective, so there was little or no glare when viewing in a brightly lit room or outdoors. The display has a wide viewing angle, especially important if more than one person needs to see the screen at a time, say, for a video or presentation. Its display produces a smaller array of colors than on most other tested laptops.

Useful features and attributes on this model include: The 128GB solid-state drive uses less power and accesses data more quickly than conventional hard-disk drives. You can connect common external devices such as hard drives and Blu-ray burners using USB 3.2 Gen 1 (5 Gbps) for maximum performance. Gigabit ethernet provides fast transfer of data over a local network. This laptop has a full-size HDMI port for connecting to an HDTV or monitor.

Downsides: There's no optical drive like a CD or DVD reader, so you'll have to buy an external drive if you need one. There is no memory-card reader, so you'll need to buy an external reader or connect your digital camera directly to this laptop to transfer photos.

attributes.name: Display size

attributes.name: Processor brand
attributes.description: Also known as the CPU (Central Processing Unit), the processor is responsible for running commands and handling data. attributes.name: Processor model name
attributes.description: Also known as the CPU (Central Processing Unit), the processor is responsible for running commands and handling data. attributes.name: Memory

attributes.name: Storage

attributes.name: Video memory

attributes.name: Native resolution

attributes.name: Video adapter

Otherwise, buy a discrete graphics adapter with a graphics processor from ATI or Nvidia with at least 256 MB of memory.

attributes.name: Optical drive

attributes.name: Height
attributes.description: The height from the table, or thickness, of the computer while closed. This includes the keyboard dock on detachable laptops.

attributes.name: Depth
attributes.description: The depth, from the front edge to the back hinge, of the computer while closed. This includes the keyboard dock for detachable laptops.

attributes.name: Width

attributes.name: Thin and light

attributes.name: Warranty length

attributes.name: Battery capacity

attributes.name: Blu-ray or DVD

attributes.name: Fingerprint reader

attributes.name: Gigabit Ethernet

attributes.name: HDMI output

expertReview.summary: An all-in-one desktop computer with a 23.8-inch screen, tested with Windows 11 Home, an Intel Core i3-1215U 2.5GHz processor, 8GB of memory, a 512GB solid-state drive, an integrated Intel UHD Graphics, and built-in speakers.
expertReview.bottomLine: A high-performing desktop, this Aspire C24-1700-UA91 from Acer should show a lag in speed when running demanding video games and media editing. Its 23.8-inch Full HD IPS display provides very good colors with a slight yellowish tint. The 512GB solid-state drive provides both fast loading speeds and plenty of storage, and it comes with a wireless keyboard and mouse. It has five USB ports for connecting peripherals.
expertReview.highs:
• Fine display with little or no glare
• Fast 802.11ac WiFi is built-in
expertReview.lows:
• Lacks an optical drive
• Lacks a memory-card reader
expertReview.description:
The Acer Aspire C24-1700-UA91 is an all-in-one desktop computer with a 23.8-inch screen. It has 8GB of memory and a 512GB solid-state drive. It has an Intel Core i3-1215U 2.5GHz processor and an integrated Intel UHD Graphics. It is not suitable for high-performance gaming. However, it lacks an optical drive for burning CDs or DVDs. It comes with Windows 11 Home pre-installed.

It has 3 full-size and 1 type-C USB ports in the rear and 1 full-size USB ports accessible from the front or sides. 1 of these ports is used by a device, leaving 4 free USB ports. It supports WiFi 5 (802.11ac), so it's compatible with high-speed routers. It also supports WiFi 6 (802.11ax), which provides faster and more dependable High Efficiency Wireless, but you'll need a compatible router to see the faster speeds. It has Bluetooth 5.0 built-in. There is a privacy cover you can slide over the webcam to hide it when not in use.

The Aspire C24-1700-UA91 measures 21.3 inches wide by 16 inches high by 7.7 inches deep. As an all-in-one desktop computer, the display and computer are combined into one device. Dimensions include the full depth of the stand, with the display set back at a 10 degree angle. It is backed by a 12-month warranty, with 12 months of free tech support by telephone.
expertReview.review:
Performance: Overall this desktop's performance was good, below that of many other models but still powerful enough for tasks such as email, word processing, web browsing, and streaming movies. Compared to other tested desktops, it was fast for common tasks such as web browsing and video conferencing. Applications start up quickly. Speed was adequate when composing documents, working on data spreadsheets, and other productivity tasks, and its speed was adequate for manipulating filters on images, converting and editing videos, and rendering models and calculating simulations.

Ergonomics: The desktop is bundled with a keyboard and mouse. Its features were well-designed, and it was comfortable and convenient to use. The keyboard and mouse are both wireless, adding to convenience when placing them. Keyboard letters were high contrast and easy to read, but its keys were smaller-sized and may be uncomfortable to type on. Keyboard features such as media playback and volume control keys add convenience. The wireless mouse has a scroll wheel. You can't easily replace the storage drive. The power button is in a convenient location that is unlikely to be pressed accidentally.

Display: The display quality was Very Good overall. Colors were accurately reproduced, realistic, and natural looking. The desktop's display was anti-reflective, so there was little or no glare when viewing in a brightly lit room. The display has a wide viewing angle, especially important if more than one person needs to see the screen at a time, say, for a video or presentation.

Useful features and attributes on this model include: You can connect common external devices such as hard drives and Blu-ray burners using USB 3.2 Gen 2 (10 Gbps). Gigabit ethernet provides fast transfer of data over a local network. Video outputs include: an HDMI full-size port; these are useful for connecting to an HDTV or separate monitor.

Downsides: There is no memory-card reader, so you'll need to buy an external reader or connect your digital camera directly to this desktop to transfer photos. There's no optical drive like a CD or DVD reader, so you'll have to buy an external drive if you need one.

expertReview.summary: A 15.6-inch laptop tested with Windows 11 Home, an Intel Core i7-1195G7 2.9GHz processor, 16GB of memory, Intel Iris Xe Graphics graphics, and a 512GB solid-state drive.
expertReview.bottomLine: The Acer Aspire Vero AV15-51-7617 is a 15.6-inch laptop. This laptop is Very Good for complex productivity work, but you may notice a slowdown during more demanding video games or graphical tasks. Its display is Excellent with better contrast, near accurate colors, but a little yellowish tone. This laptop has an average battery life for web browsing and video playback for its size category. It is marketed as a "Green PC" made from recycled materials and focuses on sustainability.
expertReview.highs:
• At 3.9 lbs, this laptop is lighter than typical laptops of this size category
• Comes with a large amount of total storage space
• Comes with a fast, more efficient solid-state drive
• Has a fingerprint reader
expertReview.lows:
• No optical drive
• Lacks a memory card reader
expertReview.description:
The Acer Aspire Vero AV15-51-7617 is a 15.6-inch laptop with a screen resolution of 1920 x 1080. It has 16GB of memory and a 512GB solid-state drive. It has an Intel Core i7-1195G7 2.9GHz processor and an integrated Intel Iris Xe Graphics. It lacks an optical drive for burning CDs or DVDs. It was tested with Windows 11 Home installed.

It has 3 full-size, 1 type-C USB ports built-in on the laptop. Video outputs include: an HDMI full-size port. It supports WiFi 5 (802.11ac), so it's compatible with high-speed routers. It also supports WiFi 6 (802.11ax), which provides faster and more dependable High Efficiency Wireless, but you'll need a compatible router to see the faster speeds. Gigabit ethernet is built-in on the laptop. It has Bluetooth 5.2 built-in. It has a 0.9MP webcam for video conferencing. Acer calls this laptop a "Green PC" made from recycled materials and designed with sustainability in mind. The tested model came bundled with a carrying case also made from recycled materials.

The Acer Aspire Vero AV15-51-7617 measures 14.3 inches wide by 9.8 inches deep by 0.9 inches high, and it weighs 3.9 lbs. It's backed by a 12-month warranty, with 12 months of free tech support over telephone.
expertReview.review:
Performance: Overall this laptop's performance was Good, below that of many other models but still powerful enough for tasks such as email, word processing, web browsing, and streaming movies. Compared to other tested laptops, it was among the fastest with common tasks such as web browsing and video conferencing. Applications start up almost instantly. Performance was okay but on the slow side when composing documents, working on data spreadsheets, and running other productivity tasks, and it was slow for manipulating images, editing videos, and calculating simulations.

Portability: This laptop is a Very Good choice for traveling. Battery life lasted 10.25 hours in a light load of web browsing tests, and 8.5 hours in a heavier load of 4K video playback tests. Results could get you through a typical workday, under a workload of mixed use. At 3.9 lbs, this laptop is lightweight for a laptop of this size category.

Ergonomics: Some features of the keyboard, touchpad, and labeling, were well-designed, and were comfortable or convenient to use. The keyboard has large keys and was comfortably sized. Its high contrast letters were easy to read, and the backlighting can be useful in dark rooms. There's a dedicated number pad for faster data entry. The power button was well labeled and conveniently located. The display feels more flexible than most other laptops.

Display: The display quality was Excellent overall. Colors were near-accurate, and mostly realistic and natural looking. The laptop's display was brighter than most and it's anti-reflective, a plus for viewing in a brightly lit room or outdoors. The display has a wide viewing angle, especially important if more than one person needs to see the screen at a time, say, for a video or presentation. Its display has better contrast than on most other tested laptops.

Useful features and attributes on this model include: The 512GB solid-state drive uses less power and accesses data more quickly than conventional hard-disk drives. You can connect common external devices such as hard drives and Blu-ray burners using USB 3.2 Gen 1 (5 Gbps) for maximum performance. The fingerprint reader lets you log into your computer without typing in a password. Gigabit ethernet provides fast transfer of data over a local network. This laptop has a full-size HDMI port for connecting to an HDTV or monitor.

Downsides: There's no optical drive like a CD or DVD reader, so you'll have to buy an external drive if you need one. There is no memory-card reader, so you'll need to buy an external reader or connect your digital camera directly to this laptop to transfer photos.

attributes.name: Versatility
