attributes.name: Battery Life - web
attributes.description: The time it takes to deplete a fully charged battery while the laptop loads a sequence of web pages over WiFi. Bluetooth and 3G/4G are disabled and the screen is set to a specific brightness that's usable indoors or outdoors.

attributes.name: Battery Life - video
attributes.description: The time it takes to deplete a fully charged battery while the laptop loops a 4K video. Bluetooth and 3G/4G are disabled and the screen is set to a specific brightness that's usable indoors or outdoors.

attributes.name: Weight
attributes.description: The weight of the laptop as you would carry it around, including the battery but without the power adapter or a removable CD/DVD drive. Detachable laptops include the weight of the keyboard.

attributes.name: OS
attributes.description: The operating system that was installed on the computer at the time it was tested. The operating system is the software that controls the basic operation of the computer. Common examples are Windows and Mac OS. The operating system determines the "look and feel" of the PC.

attributes.name: Touch screen
attributes.description: Denotes presence of a touchscreen, which is sensitive to finger contact, letting you select and move screen objects, launch programs, choose from menus, scroll through photo libraries, and the like. Some touchscreens have "multi-touch", letting you use more than one finger to resize and rotate objects.

attributes.name: 2-in-1
attributes.description: Laptop is able to convert by folding, rotating, or spinning into a tablet form factor or the screen detaches from the keyboard so you carry it as a tablet. "C" denotes convertible, "D" denotes detachable and "-" denotes a standard clamshell laptop.

attributes.name: Display size
attributes.description: The diagonal measure of the LCD (Liquid Crystal Display) screen.

attributes.name: Operating system (as tested)
attributes.description: The operating system that was installed on the computer at the time it was tested. The operating system is the software that controls the basic operation of the computer. Common examples are Windows and Mac OS. The operating system determines the "look and feel" of the PC.

attributes.name: Processor brand
attributes.description: Also known as the CPU (Central Processing Unit), the processor is responsible for running commands and handling data. Processors come in different speeds and may have two or more cores (ex. dual-core), which let you more quickly process multiple complex tasks. This is the brand, or manufacturer, of the processor.

attributes.name: Processor model name
attributes.description: Also known as the CPU (Central Processing Unit), the processor is responsible for running commands and handling data. Processors come in different speeds and may have two or more cores (ex. dual-core), which let you more quickly process multiple complex tasks. This is the listed model name and speed for the processor.

attributes.name: Memory
attributes.description: Also known as RAM, memory is a temporary storage area for data. Its size is an important factor for performance. We recommend at least 4GB of memory, or 8GB if you plan to run several large applications at the same time.

attributes.name: Storage
attributes.description: The amount of storage, a permanent area for the operating system, programs and data such as documents, music, and media files. Storage can be a hard drive, an SSD (solid state drive), or hybrid drive.

attributes.name: Video memory
attributes.description: The amount of dedicated memory built into a graphics adapter. Most models have integrated graphics, which have no dedicated memory but are still suitable for most applications, including photo editing and watching movies. Others have discrete graphic adapters, which typically have 1 GB or more of dedicated video memory, to deliver smoother and more realistic graphics for 3D games.

attributes.name: Native resolution
attributes.description: The number of picture elements ("pixels") across the horizontal and vertical dimension of the screen. The higher the resolution within a given size screen, the finer the detail that can be displayed. No scaling is needed to view a picture or movie of this size, or to match the display resolution with the native resolution, sometimes called Default or Recommended.

attributes.name: Video adapter
attributes.description: Also known as the video card, the video adapter processes all the data that you see on your screen. They come in different speeds and may be integrated (most common, but is slower and uses up memory) or discrete (which is faster and has its own dedicated memory). If you will not be playing complex 3D games, any integrated graphics adapter will do. Otherwise, buy a discrete graphics adapter with a graphics processor from ATI or Nvidia with at least 256 MB of memory.

attributes.name: Optical drive
attributes.description: The optical drive reads and/or writes to CDs and DVDs. Most PCs come equipped with a DVD-RW, also known as a DVD burner, which lets you read and write to DVDs. Some models come with Blu-Ray drives, which let you play high-definition movies.

attributes.name: Height
attributes.description: The height from the table, or thickness, of the computer while closed. This includes the keyboard dock on detachable laptops.

attributes.name: Depth
attributes.description: The depth, from the front edge to the back hinge, of the computer while closed. This includes the keyboard dock for detachable laptops.

attributes.name: Width
attributes.description: The width of the computer while closed. This includes the keyboard dock of detachable laptops.

attributes.name: Thin and light
attributes.description: Based on weight and thickness. This includes laptops that may be labeled "Ultrabook," "Sleekbook," "Thin and light," and "Ultrathin," among other terms.

attributes.name: Warranty length
attributes.description: The length in months of the manufacturer's standard warranty.

attributes.name: Tech support length
attributes.description: The length in months of the manufacturer's free technical support by telephone.

attributes.name: Battery capacity
attributes.description: The total energy contained in the battery, expressed in Watt-hours. A larger capacity battery will deliver longer battery life, but will add weight and sometimes will extend beyond the edge of the laptop.

attributes.name: Comes in S Mode
attributes.description: Windows computers that come in S Mode can only run apps from the Microsoft Store. This is one way to ensure system security and stability. They can be switched out of S Mode for free, allowing them to run third-party applications. We test computers switched out of S Mode.

attributes.name: Suitable for gaming
attributes.description: All systems can play casual games such as solitaire and Angry Birds. Systems designated as suitable for gaming are more powerful and can play modern mainstream and intensive 3D video games with a frame rate and visual effects that does not make the game stop or stutter.

attributes.name: Blu-ray or DVD
attributes.description: Has either a Blu-Ray drive (B), which lets you watch Blu-Ray movies and read/write to CDs and DVDs, or a DVD drive (D), which lets you read/write to CDs and DVDs. Some computers have no optical drive installed (—).

attributes.name: Memory-card reader
attributes.description: At least one flash memory-card slot (CF, SD, XD, MS, etc.)

attributes.name: Facial recognition
attributes.description: Webcam can be set to scan your face for secure log-in.

attributes.name: Fingerprint reader
attributes.description: A biometric fingerprint reader for logging into your PC.

attributes.name: WiFi type
attributes.description: The type of built-in 802.11 wireless networking supported. Computers with 802.11n also support 802.11g routers. Some models with 802.11n also support the 5GHz "high band," a standard suitable for apartments and other crowded areas.

attributes.name: Thunderbolt port
attributes.description: Has a Thunderbolt port for connecting peripherals such as an external hard drive. This includes ports that may be on the keyboard dock of detachable laptops. Thunderbolt is a high-speed port that can connect to DVI, HDMI and VGA through the use of adapters. Thunderbolt 3 is the newest version that supports faster speeds.

attributes.name: Digital video out
attributes.description: Has an HDMI, DisplayPort, or Thunderbolt video output for sending a digital video signal to a computer monitor or HDTV.

attributes.name: Number of USB ports
attributes.description: Number of USB ports for printers, flash drives, or other peripherals. This includes ports that may be on the keyboard dock of detachable laptops.

attributes.name: Gigabit Ethernet
attributes.description: Support for 1,000 Mb/s networking.

attributes.name: HDMI output
attributes.description: An HDMI out port for sending a digital video/audio signal to a computer monitor or HDTV.

ownerSatisfaction.infoText: Owner satisfaction ratings are based on the proportion of members who are extremely likely to recommend their laptop to their friends and family.

expertReview.summary: A compact desktop computer, tested with Windows 10 Home, an Intel Core i5-11400 2.6GHz processor, 8GB of memory, a 512GB solid-state drive, an integrated Intel UHD Graphics 730 video adapter, a DVD burner, and no speakers.
expertReview.bottomLine: The Acer Aspire XC-1660G-UW93 comes with an Intel Core i5-11400 2.6GHz processor, 8GB RAM, and integrated graphics. Also, it has 512GB of SSD storage space that can load up Windows and large programs quickly and is ideal for local backups. This desktop has speeds suited for office work and basic tasks but may slow down with demanding graphics or media processing.
expertReview.highs: • Fast 802.11ac WiFi is built-in
expertReview.lows: • Lacks a memory-card reader
expertReview.description:
The Acer Aspire XC-1660G-UW93 is a compact desktop computer. It has 8GB of memory and a 512GB solid-state drive. It has an Intel Core i5-11400 2.6GHz processor and an integrated Intel UHD Graphics 730 video adapter. It is not suitable for high-performance gaming. It comes with Windows 10 Home pre-installed.

It has 6 full-size USB ports in the rear and 1 full-size and 1 type-C USB port accessible from the front or sides. 2 of these ports are used by devices, leaving 6 free USB ports. It supports WiFi 5 (802.11ac), so it's compatible with high-speed routers. It also supports WiFi 6 (802.11ax), which provides faster and more dependable High Efficiency Wireless, but you'll need a compatible router to see the faster speeds. It has Bluetooth 5.0 built-in.

The Aspire XC-1660G-UW93 measures 4 inches wide by 11.7 inches high by 13.5 inches deep. As a compact desktop computer, the case is smaller than a typical tower and is designed to take up less desk space. It is backed by a 12-month warranty, with 12 months of free tech support by telephone.
expertReview.review:
Performance: Overall this desktop's performance was good, below that of many other models but still powerful enough for tasks such as email, word processing, web browsing, and streaming movies. Compared to other tested desktops, its speed was adequate for common tasks such as web browsing, video conferencing, and application startup. Speed was adequate when composing documents, working on data spreadsheets, and other productivity tasks, and it was slow for manipulating images, editing videos, and calculating simulations.

Ergonomics: The desktop is bundled with a keyboard and mouse. It had well-designed features that made it comfortable or convenient to use. Keyboard letters were high contrast and easy to read, but its keys were smaller-sized and may be uncomfortable to type on. Keyboard features such as media playback and volume control keys add convenience. The corded mouse has a scroll wheel. The storage drive can be easily replaced. The power button is in a convenient location that is unlikely to be pressed accidentally. The case has no easily viewed LED indicator for CD activity.

Useful features and attributes on this model include: You can connect common external devices such as hard drives and Blu-ray burners using USB 3.2 Gen 2 (10 Gbps). Gigabit ethernet provides fast transfer of data over a local network. Video outputs include: an HDMI full-size port; these are useful for connecting to an HDTV or separate monitor.

Downsides: There is no memory-card reader, so you'll need to buy an external reader or connect your digital camera directly to this desktop to transfer photos.

expertReview.summary: A 14-inch Chromebook tested with Chrome OS 99.0, MediaTek MT8183 2GHz processor, 4GB of memory, ARM Mali G72 video adapter, and a 32GB eMMC drive. This model will receive updates from Google up until June 2028.
expertReview.bottomLine: This 14-inch Acer Chromebook is an above-average-rated Chromebook among the tested Chromebooks. Its processing speeds are in the lower range compared to other Chromebooks, and its weight is an average of 2.8 lbs., but battery life is above average at 15.5 hours of web browsing. Its display produces pale colors on a 14" HD anti-glare screen. It's a good choice for keeping up on work while out on your travels.
expertReview.highs: • Long battery life could last beyond a full day's work
expertReview.lows:
• Shows slow speeds in our performance tests
• No memory card reader
expertReview.description:
The Acer Chromebook 314 C922-K04T is a 14-inch Chromebook with a screen resolution of 1366 x 768. It has 4GB of memory and a 32GB eMMC drive. It has an MediaTek MT8183 2GHz processor and an ARM Mali G72 video adapter but no dedicated video memory. It was tested with Chrome OS 99.0. This model will receive updates from Google up until June 2028.

It has and 1 full-size and 1 type-C USB ports. However, you'll lose a USB port to plug in the power cable when charging the Chromebook. Video outputs include: an HDMI full-size port, supporting DisplayPort over USB-C. It supports WiFi 5 (802.11ac), so it's compatible with high-speed routers. It has Bluetooth 5.0 built-in. Google Play is available for downloading Android apps and games. The MT8183 chip is composed of ARM Cortex A73 and A53 cores.

The Acer Chromebook 314 C922-K04T measures 12.8 inches wide by 0.8 inches deep by 9.1 inches high, and it weighs 2.8 lbs. It's backed by a 12-month warranty, with 12 months of free tech support over telephone.
expertReview.review:
Performance: Performance was only fair. Speed was slow but adequate for productivity and Web-based tasks such as word processing, Web browsing, and online game play.

Portability: This Chromebook is an Excellent choice for traveling. Battery life lasted 15.5 hours in a light load of web browsing tests, and 6 hours in a heavier load of 4K video playback tests. Results were notably longer than many similar Chromebooks, under a workload of mixed use. In heavier loads, the battery lasted shorter than expected, so you're more likely to need a charge as you run more performance intensive tasks. At 2.8 lbs, weight was typical for a Chromebook this size and light enough to carry for long periods of time.

Ergonomics: The keyboard and case were well-designed, making it comfortable and convenient to use. The keyboard has large keys and was comfortably sized. Its high contrast letters were easy to read. The power button was well labeled and conveniently located. The touchpad was among the largest of those tested, and provides ample space for different touch gestures. The touchpad can get noisy when clicking.

Display: The display quality was Good overall. Colors were in the ballpark, though not completely accurate. The display was anti-reflective, so there was little or no glare when viewing in a brightly lit room or outdoors. The display had a narrow viewing angle, so you'll have limited flexibility in how to position the screen for optimal viewability for one user, and it will be difficult for more than one person to look at the screen at the same time. Its display has worse contrast than on most other tested Chromebooks.

Useful features and attributes on this model include: You can connect common external devices such as hard drives and DVD players using USB 3.0 (5 Gbps) for maximum performance. This Chromebook has a full-size HDMI port and supports DisplayPort over USB-C for connecting to an HDTV or monitor.

Downsides: There is no memory-card reader, so you'll need to buy an external reader or connect your digital camera directly to this laptop to transfer photos.

expertReview.summary: A 14-inch Chromebook tested with Chrome OS 100.0, Intel Core i3-1115G4 3GHz processor, 8GB of memory, Intel UHD Graphics video adapter, a touchscreen, and a 128GB solid-state drive. This model will receive updates from Google up until June 2029.
expertReview.bottomLine: This 14-inch Acer has the speeds to power through complex productivity work, and it has 128GB of storage for local backups. Its display produces pale colors with a green hue on a 14-inch Full HD touch display and has a shorter than average battery life of 9 hours in web browsing tests and average battery life of 6.25 hours in video playback.
expertReview.highs:
• Shows fast speeds in our performance tests
• Touchscreen provides a convenient way to navigate and interact
• Backlit keyboard helps with typing in darker rooms
• More local storage space than most other Chromebooks
• Over 5.5 years of updates are remaining before expiration
expertReview.lows: • Nothing significant
expertReview.description:
The Acer Chromebook 514 CB514-1WT-3481 is a 14-inch Chromebook with a screen resolution of 1920 x 1080. It has 8GB of memory and a 128GB solid-state drive. It has an Intel Core i3-1115G4 3GHz processor and an Intel UHD Graphics video adapter but no dedicated video memory. It was tested with Chrome OS 100.0. This model will receive updates from Google up until June 2029.

It has a built-in microSD memory card reader for digital photography, a touch screen, and 1 full-size and 2 type-C USB ports. However, you'll lose a USB port to plug in the power cable when charging the Chromebook. Video outputs include: an HDMI full-size port, supporting Thunderbolt 4 (40 Gbps) and DisplayPort over USB-C. It supports WiFi 5 (802.11ac), so it's compatible with high-speed routers. It also supports WiFi 6 (802.11ax), which provides faster and more dependable High Efficiency Wireless, but you'll need a compatible router to see the faster speeds. It has Bluetooth 5.0 built-in. It has a manual sliding cover to hide the webcam when not in use. Google Play is available for downloading Android apps and games.

The Acer Chromebook 514 CB514-1WT-3481 measures 12.7 inches wide by 0.8 inches deep by 8.7 inches high, and it weighs 3 lbs. It's backed by a 12-month warranty, with 12 months of free tech support over telephone.
expertReview.review:
Performance: Performance was very good. Speed was above average for productivity and Web-based tasks such as word processing, Web browsing, and online game play. Since there are few instances where you will be working on multiple tasks simultaneously, you may rarely see the increased performance.

Portability: This Chromebook is a Very Good choice for traveling. Battery life lasted 9 hours in a light load of web browsing tests, and 6.25 hours in a heavier load of 4K video playback tests. Results could get you through a typical workday, under a workload of mixed use. At 3 lbs, weight was typical for a Chromebook this size and light enough to carry for long periods of time.

Ergonomics: The keyboard and case were well-designed, making it comfortable and convenient to use. The keyboard has large keys and was comfortably sized. Its high contrast letters were easy to read, and the backlighting can be useful in dark rooms. The power button was well labeled and conveniently located. Friction on the touchscreen may prevent fast swiping, and fingerprints may take some effort to clean off.

Display: The display quality was Very Good overall. Colors were not reproduced as accurately as on better displays. The display was anti-reflective, so there was little or no glare when viewing in a brightly lit room or outdoors. The display has a wide viewing angle, especially important if more than one person needs to see the screen at a time, say, for a video or presentation.

Useful features and attributes on this model include: The Chromebook has a touchscreen for navigation and interaction directly on the display. Its storage space of 128GB is larger than most other Chromebooks, good for storing local backup files. You can connect common external devices such as hard drives and DVD players using Thunderbolt 4 (40 Gbps) for maximum performance. This Chromebook has a full-size HDMI port and supports DisplayPort over USB-C for connecting to an HDTV or monitor. This model still has most of its lifespan remaining during which Google will continue to update the OS.

Downsides: The power supply adds about 0.6 lbs, which is heavy compared to the laptop weight.

attributes.name: Ergonomics
attributes.description: Represents the quality of the keyboard and pointing device, and accessibility of features.

attributes.name: Portability
attributes.description: Portability is based on the size and weight of the unit, as well as battery life.

attributes.name: Display
attributes.description: Covers display size, clarity, color, brightness, and glare.

attributes.name: Performance
attributes.description: Based on performance while running HTML5, WebGL and JavaScript benchmarks.

attributes.name: Versatility
attributes.description: Includes hardware such as memory-card slots, WiFi, storage and AV connections and tech support and warranty provisions.

attributes.name: Display size
attributes.description: The diagonal measure of the LCD (Liquid Crystal Display) screen.

attributes.name: Battery Life - web
attributes.description: The time it takes to deplete a fully charged battery while the Chromebook loads a sequence of web pages over WiFi. The screen is set to a specific brightness that's usable indoors or outdoors.

attributes.name: Battery Life - video
attributes.description: The time it takes to deplete a fully charged battery while the Chromebook loops a 4K video. The screen is set to a specific brightness that's usable indoors or outdoors.

attributes.name: Weight
attributes.description: The weight of the Chromebook as you would carry it around, including the battery but without the power adapter.

attributes.name: Touch screen
attributes.description: Display that is sensitive to finger contact, letting you select and move screen objects, launch programs, choose from menus, scroll through photo libraries, and the like. Many touchscreens have "multi-touch", letting you use more than one finger to resize and rotate objects.

attributes.name: 2-in-1
attributes.description: Chromebook is able to convert by folding, rotating, or spinning into a tablet form factor so you carry it as a tablet. "C" denotes convertible, "D" denotes detachable, and "-" denotes a standard Chromebook.

attributes.name: Processor
attributes.description: Also known as the CPU (Central Processing Unit), the processor is responsible for running commands and handling data. Processors come in different speeds and may have two or more cores (ex. dual-core), which let you more quickly process multiple complex tasks.

attributes.name: Memory
attributes.description: Also known as RAM, memory is a temporary storage area for data. Its size is an important factor for performance.

attributes.name: Storage
attributes.description: The amount of storage, a permanent area for the operating system, programs and data such as documents, music, and media files. Storage can be a hard drive, an SSD (solid state drive), or hybrid drive.

attributes.name: Native resolution
attributes.description: The number of picture elements ("pixels") across the horizontal and vertical dimension of the screen. The higher the resolution within a given size screen, the finer the detail that can be displayed. No scaling is needed to view a picture or movie of this size, or to match the display resolution with the native resolution, sometimes called Default or Recommended.

attributes.name: Video adapter
attributes.description: Also known as the video card, the video adapter processes all the data that you see on your screen. They come in different speeds and may be integrated (most common, but is slower and uses up memory) or discrete (which is faster and has its own dedicated memory).

attributes.name: Width
attributes.description: The width of the Chromebook while closed.

attributes.name: Height
attributes.description: The height from the table, or thickness, of the Chromebook while closed.

attributes.name: Depth
attributes.description: The depth, from the front edge to the back hinge, of the Chromebook while closed.

attributes.name: Thin and light
attributes.description: Based on weight and thickness. This includes Chromebooks that may be labeled "Ultrabook," "Sleekbook," "Thin and light," and "Ultrathin," among other terms.

attributes.name: Operating system (as tested)
attributes.description: The operating system that was installed on the computer at the time it was tested. The operating system is the software that controls the basic operation of the computer.

attributes.name: Warranty length
attributes.description: The length in months of the manufacturer's standard warranty.

attributes.name: Tech support length
attributes.description: The length in months of the manufacturer's free technical support by telephone.

attributes.name: Battery capacity
attributes.description: The total energy contained in the battery, expressed in Watt-hours. A larger capacity battery will deliver longer battery life, but will add weight and sometimes will extend beyond the edge of the Chromebook.

attributes.name: Auto update expiration date
attributes.description: Assigned by Google, the expiration date is when this Chromebook will stop receiving system updates. Depending on its hardware, each model receives a date about 6.5 years from the date of initial release. This is one way to encourage updated hardware from both manufacturers and consumers, and ensure system security and stability.

attributes.name: Memory-card reader
attributes.description: At least one flash memory-card slot (CF, SD, XD, MS, etc.)

attributes.name: Built-in webcam
attributes.description: A built-in webcam for videoconferencing.

attributes.name: WiFi
attributes.description: The type of built-in 802.11 wireless networking supported. Chromebooks with 802.11n also support 802.11g routers. Some models with 802.11n also support the 5GHz "high band," a standard suitable for apartments and other crowded areas. 802.11ac is the newest, fastest type.

attributes.name: Gigabit Ethernet
attributes.description: Support for 1000 Mb/s networking.

attributes.name: Number of USB ports
attributes.description: Number of USB ports for printers, flash drives, or other peripherals.

attributes.name: HDMI output
attributes.description: An HDMI out port for sending a digital video/audio signal to a computer monitor or HDTV.

expertReview.summary: A 15.6-inch Chromebook tested with Chrome OS 102.0, Intel Core i5-1145G7 2.6GHz processor, 16GB of memory, Intel Xe Graphics video adapter, and a 256GB solid-state drive. This model will receive updates from Google up until June 2029.
expertReview.bottomLine: This Acer Chromebook 515 CB515-1W-50FL with the Intel Core i5-1145G7 2.6GHz chip is a standout among other Chromebooks. Its speeds are one of the fastest we've seen, outpacing most other models. Its display produces pale colors with a slight yellowish skin tone on a 15.6-inch Full HD touch display. However, it does have a shorter than average battery life of 9.75 hours in web browsing tests and average battery life of 7.25 hours in video playback. This Chromebook has more storage than most others making it great for local backups. It's an excellent choice for keeping up on work while out on your travels.
expertReview.highs:
• A high performer with one of the fastest speeds among rated models
• Backlit keyboard helps with typing in darker rooms
• More local storage space than most other Chromebooks
• Over 5.5 years of updates are remaining before expiration
expertReview.lows: • Nothing significant
expertReview.description:
The Acer Chromebook 515 CB515-1W-50FL is a 15.6-inch Chromebook with a screen resolution of 1920 x 1080. It has 16GB of memory and a 256GB solid-state drive. It has an Intel Core i5-1145G7 2.6GHz processor and an Intel Xe Graphics video adapter but no dedicated video memory. It was tested with Chrome OS 102.0. This model will receive updates from Google up until June 2029.

It has a built-in microSD memory card reader for digital photography, and 1 full-size and 2 type-C USB ports. However, you'll lose a USB port to plug in the power cable when charging the Chromebook. Video outputs include: an HDMI full-size port, supporting DisplayPort over USB-C. It supports WiFi 5 (802.11ac), so it's compatible with high-speed routers. It also supports WiFi 6 (802.11ax), which provides faster and more dependable High Efficiency Wireless, but you'll need a compatible router to see the faster speeds. It has Bluetooth 5.0 built-in. It has a manual sliding cover to hide the webcam when not in use. Google Play is available for downloading Android apps and games.

The Acer Chromebook 515 CB515-1W-50FL measures 14.1 inches wide by 1 inches deep by 9.5 inches high, and it weighs 3.7 lbs. It's backed by a 12-month warranty, with 12 months of free tech support over telephone.
expertReview.review:
Performance: Performance was excellent. Speed was tops for productivity and Web-based tasks such as word processing, Web browsing, and online game play. You'll have performance room to grow.

Portability: This Chromebook is a Very Good choice for traveling. Battery life lasted 9.75 hours in a light load of web browsing tests, and 7.25 hours in a heavier load of 4K video playback tests. Results could get you through a typical workday, under a workload of mixed use. In heavier loads, the battery lasted longer than expected, so you're less likely to need a charge as you run more performance intensive tasks. At 3.7 lbs, weight was typical for a Chromebook this size and light enough to carry for long periods of time.

Ergonomics: The keyboard and case were well-designed, making it comfortable and convenient to use. The keyboard has large keys and was comfortably sized. Its high contrast letters were easy to read, and the backlighting can be useful in dark rooms. The power button was well labeled and conveniently located. The touchpad was among the largest of those tested, and provides ample space for different touch gestures.

Display: The display quality was Very Good overall. Colors were in the ballpark, though not completely accurate. The display was anti-reflective, so there was little or no glare when viewing in a brightly lit room or outdoors. The display has a wide viewing angle, especially important if more than one person needs to see the screen at a time, say, for a video or presentation.

Useful features and attributes on this model include: Its storage space of 256GB is larger than most other Chromebooks, good for storing local backup files. You can connect common external devices such as hard drives and DVD players using USB 3.2 Gen 2 (10 Gbps) for maximum performance. This Chromebook has a full-size HDMI port and supports DisplayPort over USB-C for connecting to an HDTV or monitor. This model still has most of its lifespan remaining during which Google will continue to update the OS.

Downsides: No significant negative features.

expertReview.description:
The Acer Chromebook Spin 311 CP311-3H-K5WQ is an 11.6-inch convertible Chromebook with a screen resolution of 1366 x 768. It has 4GB of memory and a 64GB eMMC drive. It has an MediaTek MT8183 2GHz processor and an ARM Mali G72 video adapter but no dedicated video memory. It was tested with Chrome OS 110.0. This model will receive updates from Google up until June 2028.

It has a touch screen, and 1 full-size and 1 type-C USB ports. However, you'll lose a USB port to plug in the power cable when charging the Chromebook. It supports WiFi 5 (802.11ac), so it's compatible with high-speed routers. It has Bluetooth 4.2 built-in. It has a manual sliding cover to hide the webcam when not in use. Google Play is available for downloading Android apps and games, and it has a gyroscope and accelerometer that can enhance interaction.

The Acer Chromebook Spin 311 CP311-3H-K5WQ measures 11.4 inches wide by 0.8 inches deep by 8.1 inches high, and it weighs 2.4 lbs. It's backed by a 12-month warranty, with 12 months of free tech support over telephone.
expertReview.review:
Performance: Performance was only fair. Speed was slow but adequate for productivity and Web-based tasks such as word processing, Web browsing, and online game play.

Portability: This Chromebook is a Very Good choice for traveling. Battery life lasted 11.5 hours in a light load of web browsing tests, and 4.5 hours in a heavier load of 4K video playback tests. Results could get you through a typical workday, under a workload of mixed use. In heavier loads, the battery lasted shorter than expected, so you're more likely to need a charge as you run more performance intensive tasks. At 2.4 lbs, weight was typical for a Chromebook this size and light enough to carry for long periods of time.

Ergonomics: The keyboard and case were well-designed, making it comfortable and convenient to use. The keyboard has large keys and was comfortably sized. Its high contrast letters were easy to read. The power button was well-labeled, but it was inconveniently placed, either difficult to reach or too easy to accidentally press. The touchscreen is smooth enough for fast swipes, and fingerprints clean off easily.

Display: The display quality was Good overall. Colors were in the ballpark, though not completely accurate. The display has a wide viewing angle, especially important if more than one person needs to see the screen at a time, say, for a video or presentation.

Useful features and attributes on this model include: The Chromebook has a convertible form factor and can be folded backwards for use as a tablet. You can connect common external devices such as hard drives and DVD players using USB 3.1 Gen 1 (5 Gbps) for maximum performance.

Downsides: There is no memory-card reader, so you'll need to buy an external reader or connect your digital camera directly to this laptop to transfer photos. The power supply adds about 0.5 lbs, which is heavy compared to the laptop weight.

attributes.name: Performance
attributes.description: Based on performance while running HTML5, WebGL and JavaScript benchmarks.

attributes.name: Versatility
attributes.description: Includes hardware such as memory-card slots, WiFi, storage and AV connections and tech support and warranty provisions.

attributes.name: Display size
attributes.description: The diagonal measure of the LCD (Liquid Crystal Display) screen.

attributes.name: Battery Life - web
attributes.description: The time it takes to deplete a fully charged battery while the Chromebook loads a sequence of web pages over WiFi. The screen is set to a specific brightness that's usable indoors or outdoors.

attributes.name: Battery Life - video
attributes.description: The time it takes to deplete a fully charged battery while the Chromebook loops a 4K video. The screen is set to a specific brightness that's usable indoors or outdoors.

attributes.name: Weight
attributes.description: The weight of the Chromebook as you would carry it around, including the battery but without the power adapter.

attributes.name: Touch screen
attributes.description: Display that is sensitive to finger contact, letting you select and move screen objects, launch programs, choose from menus, scroll through photo libraries, and the like. Many touchscreens have "multi-touch", letting you use more than one finger to resize and rotate objects.

attributes.name: 2-in-1
attributes.description: Chromebook is able to convert by folding, rotating, or spinning into a tablet form factor so you carry it as a tablet. "C" denotes convertible, "D" denotes detachable, and "-" denotes a standard Chromebook.

attributes.name: Processor
attributes.description: Also known as the CPU (Central Processing Unit), the processor is responsible for running commands and handling data. Processors come in different speeds and may have two or more cores (ex. dual-core), which let you more quickly process multiple complex tasks.

attributes.name: Memory
attributes.description: Also known as RAM, memory is a temporary storage area for data. Its size is an important factor for performance.

attributes.name: Storage
attributes.description: The amount of storage, a permanent area for the operating system, programs and data such as documents, music, and media files. Storage can be a hard drive, an SSD (solid state drive), or hybrid drive.

attributes.name: Native resolution
attributes.description: The number of picture elements ("pixels") across the horizontal and vertical dimension of the screen. The higher the resolution within a given size screen, the finer the detail that can be displayed. No scaling is needed to view a picture or movie of this size, or to match the display resolution with the native resolution, sometimes called Default or Recommended.

attributes.name: Video adapter
attributes.description: Also known as the video card, the video adapter processes all the data that you see on your screen. They come in different speeds and may be integrated (most common, but is slower and uses up memory) or discrete (which is faster and has its own dedicated memory).

attributes.name: Width
attributes.description: The width of the Chromebook while closed.

attributes.name: Height
attributes.description: The height from the table, or thickness, of the Chromebook while closed.

attributes.name: Depth
attributes.description: The depth, from the front edge to the back hinge, of the Chromebook while closed.

attributes.name: Thin and light
attributes.description: Based on weight and thickness. This includes Chromebooks that may be labeled "Ultrabook," "Sleekbook," "Thin and light," and "Ultrathin," among other terms.

attributes.name: Operating system (as tested)
attributes.description: The operating system that was installed on the computer at the time it was tested. The operating system is the software that controls the basic operation of the computer.

attributes.name: Warranty length
attributes.description: The length in months of the manufacturer's standard warranty.

attributes.name: Tech support length
attributes.description: The length in months of the manufacturer's free technical support by telephone.

attributes.name: Battery capacity
attributes.description: The total energy contained in the battery, expressed in Watt-hours. A larger capacity battery will deliver longer battery life, but will add weight and sometimes will extend beyond the edge of the Chromebook.

attributes.name: Auto update expiration date
attributes.description: Assigned by Google, the expiration date is when this Chromebook will stop receiving system updates. Depending on its hardware, each model receives a date about 6.5 years from the date of initial release. This is one way to encourage updated hardware from both manufacturers and consumers, and ensure system security and stability.

attributes.name: Memory-card reader
attributes.description: At least one flash memory-card slot (CF, SD, XD, MS, etc.)

attributes.name: Built-in webcam
attributes.description: A built-in webcam for videoconferencing.

attributes.name: WiFi
attributes.description: The type of built-in 802.11 wireless networking supported. Chromebooks with 802.11n also support 802.11g routers. Some models with 802.11n also support the 5GHz "high band," a standard suitable for apartments and other crowded areas. 802.11ac is the newest, fastest type.

attributes.name: Gigabit Ethernet
attributes.description: Support for 1000 Mb/s networking.

attributes.name: Number of USB ports
attributes.description: Number of USB ports for printers, flash drives, or other peripherals.

attributes.name: HDMI output
attributes.description: An HDMI out port for sending a digital video/audio signal to a computer monitor or HDTV.

reliability.infoText: Predicted brand reliability ratings are based on estimated problem rates for newly purchased Chromebooks, by the end of the 3rd year of ownership.

ownerSatisfaction.infoText: Owner satisfaction ratings are based on the proportion of members who are extremely likely to recommend their Chromebook to their friends and family.

expertReview.summary: A 14-inch convertible Chromebook tested with Chrome OS 98.0, Intel Core i5-1130G7 1.8GHz processor, 8GB of memory, Intel Iris Xe video adapter, a touchscreen, and a 256GB solid-state drive. This model will receive updates from Google up until June 2029.
expertReview.bottomLine: This 14-inch Acer Chromebook is an above-average-rated Chromebook among the tested Chromebooks. Its speeds are one of the fastest we've seen, outpacing most other models. Its display produces good neutral colors with a slight yellowish skin tone on a 14-inch Full HD IPS Gorilla glass touch display and convertible form-factor that lets you fold the displayed backward to use as a tablet. However, it does have a shorter than average battery life of 10.25 hours in web browsing tests and average battery life of 7.5 hours in video playback.
expertReview.highs:
• Shows fast speeds in our performance tests
• Touchscreen provides a convenient way to navigate and interact
• Backlit keyboard helps with typing in darker rooms
• More local storage space than most other Chromebooks
• Over 5.5 years of updates are remaining before expiration
expertReview.lows: • No memory card reader
expertReview.description:
The Acer Chromebook Spin 514 CP514-2H-5556 is a 14-inch convertible Chromebook with a screen resolution of 1920 x 1080. It has 8GB of memory and a 256GB solid-state drive. It has an Intel Core i5-1130G7 1.8GHz processor and an Intel Iris Xe video adapter but no dedicated video memory. It was tested with Chrome OS 98.0. This model will receive updates from Google up until June 2029.

It has a touch screen, and 1 full-size and 2 type-C USB ports. However, you'll lose a USB port to plug in the power cable when charging the Chromebook. Video outputs include: an HDMI full-size port, supporting DisplayPort over USB-C. It supports WiFi 5 (802.11ac), so it's compatible with high-speed routers. It also supports WiFi 6 (802.11ax), which provides faster and more dependable High Efficiency Wireless, but you'll need a compatible router to see the faster speeds. It has Bluetooth 5.0 built-in. Google Play is available for downloading Android apps and games, and it has a gyroscope and accelerometer that can enhance interaction.

The Acer Chromebook Spin 514 CP514-2H-5556 measures 12.6 inches wide by 0.7 inches deep by 8.2 inches high, and it weighs 3 lbs. It's backed by a 12-month warranty, with 12 months of free tech support over telephone.
expertReview.review:
Performance: Performance was very good. Speed was above average for productivity and Web-based tasks such as word processing, Web browsing, and online game play. Since there are few instances where you will be working on multiple tasks simultaneously, you may rarely see the increased performance.

Portability: This Chromebook is a Very Good choice for traveling. Battery life lasted 10.25 hours in a light load of web browsing tests, and 7.5 hours in a heavier load of 4K video playback tests. Results could get you through a typical workday, under a workload of mixed use. At 3 lbs, weight was typical for a Chromebook this size and light enough to carry for long periods of time.

Ergonomics: The keyboard and case were well-designed, making it comfortable and convenient to use. The keyboard has large keys and was comfortably sized. Its low contrast letters were difficult to read, although the backlighting can be useful in dark rooms. The power button was well-labeled, but it was inconveniently placed, either difficult to reach or too easy to accidentally press. The touchscreen is smooth enough for fast swipes, and fingerprints clean off easily. Testers liked the sturdy build of the chassis.

Display: The display quality was Very Good overall. Colors were accurately reproduced, realistic, and natural looking. The display has a wide viewing angle, especially important if more than one person needs to see the screen at a time, say, for a video or presentation. Its display has better contrast than on most other tested Chromebooks.

Useful features and attributes on this model include: The Chromebook has a convertible form factor and can be folded backwards for use as a tablet. Its storage space of 256GB is larger than most other Chromebooks, good for storing local backup files. You can connect common external devices such as hard drives and DVD players using USB 3.2 Gen 1 (5 Gbps) for maximum performance. This Chromebook has a full-size HDMI port and supports DisplayPort over USB-C for connecting to an HDTV or monitor. This model still has most of its lifespan remaining during which Google will continue to update the OS.

Downsides: There is no memory-card reader, so you'll need to buy an external reader or connect your digital camera directly to this laptop to transfer photos. The power supply adds about 0.6 lbs, which is heavy compared to the laptop weight.

expertReview.summary: A 14-inch convertible Chromebook tested with Chrome OS 101.0, Intel Core i3-1110G4 1.8GHz processor, 8GB of memory, Intel UHD Graphics video adapter, a touchscreen, and a 128GB solid-state drive. This model will receive updates from Google up until June 2029.
expertReview.bottomLine: This Acer has an excellent display among Chromebooks, with very good colors on the 14-inch Full HD IPS Gorilla Glass Touch display and a convertible form-factor that lets you fold the screen back to use as a tablet. Its processing speeds are upper-range compared to other Chromebooks, its weight of 3 lbs. is slightly heavier than the average Chromebook, and battery life is average at 11 hours of web browsing. On the other hand, its video playback of 8.25 hours is above the mid-range of tested Chromebooks.
expertReview.highs:
• Shows fast speeds in our performance tests
• Touchscreen provides a convenient way to navigate and interact
• Backlit keyboard helps with typing in darker rooms
• More local storage space than most other Chromebooks
• Over 5.5 years of updates are remaining before expiration
expertReview.lows: • No memory card reader
expertReview.description:
The Acer Chromebook Spin CP514-2H-3678 is a 14-inch convertible Chromebook with a screen resolution of 1920 x 1080. It has 8GB of memory and a 128GB solid-state drive. It has an Intel Core i3-1110G4 1.8GHz processor and an Intel UHD Graphics video adapter but no dedicated video memory. It was tested with Chrome OS 101.0. This model will receive updates from Google up until June 2029.

It has a touch screen, and 1 full-size and 2 type-C USB ports. However, you'll lose a USB port to plug in the power cable when charging the Chromebook. Video outputs include: an HDMI full-size port, supporting DisplayPort over USB-C. It supports WiFi 5 (802.11ac), so it's compatible with high-speed routers. It also supports WiFi 6 (802.11ax), which provides faster and more dependable High Efficiency Wireless, but you'll need a compatible router to see the faster speeds. It has Bluetooth 5.0 built-in. Google Play is available for downloading Android apps and games, and it has a gyroscope and accelerometer that can enhance interaction.

The Acer Chromebook Spin CP514-2H-3678 measures 12.6 inches wide by 0.7 inches deep by 8.2 inches high, and it weighs 3 lbs. It's backed by a 12-month warranty, with 12 months of free tech support over telephone.
expertReview.review:
Performance: Performance was very good. Speed was above average for productivity and Web-based tasks such as word processing, Web browsing, and online game play. Since there are few instances where you will be working on multiple tasks simultaneously, you may rarely see the increased performance.

Portability: This Chromebook is a Very Good choice for traveling. Battery life lasted 11 hours in a light load of web browsing tests, and 8.25 hours in a heavier load of 4K video playback tests. Results could get you through a typical workday, under a workload of mixed use. In heavier loads, the battery lasted longer than expected, so you're less likely to need a charge as you run more performance intensive tasks. At 3 lbs, weight was typical for a Chromebook this size and light enough to carry for long periods of time.

Ergonomics: The keyboard and case were well-designed, making it comfortable and convenient to use. The keyboard has large keys and was comfortably sized. Its low contrast letters were difficult to read, although the backlighting can be useful in dark rooms. The power button was well-labeled, but it was inconveniently placed, either difficult to reach or too easy to accidentally press. The touchscreen is smooth enough for fast swipes, and fingerprints clean off easily. Testers liked the sturdy build of the chassis.

Display: The display quality was Excellent overall. Colors were accurately reproduced, realistic, and natural looking. The display was brighter than most, a plus for viewing in bright indoor lighting or outdoors. The display has a wide viewing angle, especially important if more than one person needs to see the screen at a time, say, for a video or presentation. Its display produces a wider array of colors than on most other tested Chromebooks.

Useful features and attributes on this model include: The Chromebook has a convertible form factor and can be folded backwards for use as a tablet. Its storage space of 128GB is larger than most other Chromebooks, good for storing local backup files. You can connect common external devices such as hard drives and DVD players using USB 3.2 Gen 1 (5 Gbps) for maximum performance. This Chromebook has a full-size HDMI port and supports DisplayPort over USB-C for connecting to an HDTV or monitor. This model still has most of its lifespan remaining during which Google will continue to update the OS.

Downsides: There is no memory-card reader, so you'll need to buy an external reader or connect your digital camera directly to this laptop to transfer photos. The power supply adds about 0.6 lbs, which is heavy compared to the laptop weight.

attributes.name: Processor
attributes.description: Also known as the CPU (Central Processing Unit), the processor is responsible for running commands and handling data. Processors come in different speeds and may have two or more cores (ex. dual-core), which let you more quickly process multiple complex tasks.

attributes.name: Memory
attributes.description: Also known as RAM, memory is a temporary storage area for data. Its size is an important factor for performance.

attributes.name: Storage

attributes.name: Native resolution
attributes.description: The number of picture elements ("pixels") across the horizontal and vertical dimension of the screen. The higher the resolution within a given size screen, the finer the detail that can be displayed. No scaling is needed to view a picture or movie of this size, or to match the display resolution with the native resolution, sometimes called Default or Recommended.

attributes.name: Video adapter
attributes.description: Also known as the video card, the video adapter processes all the data that you see on your screen. They come in different speeds and may be integrated (most common, but is slower and uses up memory) or discrete (which is faster and has its own dedicated memory).

attributes.name: Width

attributes.name: Height

attributes.name: Depth

attributes.name: Thin and light

attributes.name: Operating system (as tested)

attributes.name: Warranty length

attributes.name: Tech support length

attributes.name: Battery capacity

attributes.name: Auto update expiration date
attributes.description: Assigned by Google, the expiration date is when this Chromebook will stop receiving system updates. Depending on its hardware, each model receives a date about 6.5 years from the date of initial release. This is one way to encourage updated hardware from both manufacturers and consumers, and ensure system security and stability.

attributes.name: Memory-card reader

attributes.name: Built-in webcam

attributes.name: WiFi
attributes.description: The type of built-in 802.11 wireless networking supported. Chromebooks with 802.11n also support 802.11g routers. Some models with 802.11n also support the 5GHz "high band," a standard suitable for apartments and other crowded areas. 802.11ac is the newest, fastest type.

attributes.name: Gigabit Ethernet
attributes.description: Support for 1000 Mb/s networking.

attributes.name: Number of USB ports
attributes.description: Number of USB ports for printers, flash drives, or other peripherals.

attributes.name: HDMI output

reliability.infoText: Predicted brand reliability ratings are based on estimated problem rates for newly purchased Chromebooks, by the end of the 3rd year of ownership.

expertReview.summary: An 802.11axe wireless router with 4 Gigabit Ethernet ports and 1 USB port. Does not include an Ethernet cable.
expertReview.bottomLine: The Acer Predator Connect W6 AXE7800 is an average-rated router. This router is one of the better routers for large houses, with Excellent throughput at all distances. As for IO ports, this model offers 4 Ethernet LAN ports, with one port dedicated to a game console and one USB port. It provides Very Good Data security and Fair Data privacy.
expertReview.highs:
• Supports USB 3.0 to connect to hard drives and get better performance
  • Can setup router from both a phone app and a web based wizard
expertReview.lows:
• Has no automatic firmware updating
  • Scored Fair for data privacy
expertReview.description:
The Acer Predator Connect W6 AXE7800 is a wireless router supporting 802.11ac, 802.11n (2.4 and 5GHz frequency bands), 802.11g, 802.11b, and 802.11a.

The Acer Predator Connect W6 AXE7800 supports 2.4 and 5GHz guest networks, WiFi protected setup (WPS) and has one USB port which is a USB 3.0 port for faster connections.

The Acer Predator Connect W6 AXE7800 measures 7.88 inches wide by 3.2 inches high by 7.88 inches deep and it weighs 1.97lbs. It's backed by a 12 month warranty and 24/7 tech support.

attributes.name: Data security
attributes.description: A measure of how well the device and its manufacturer protect your data with respect to authentication, encryption, software updates, resistance to known exploits, etc. based on inspection of device features and analysis of network traffic, penetration testing, and publicly-available documentation.

attributes.name: Data privacy
attributes.description: A measure of how the device and its manufacturer collect, share and use your data, and the user's ability to control the flow of their data. Analysis is based on (but, not limited to) evaluation of user interfaces and publicly-available material.

attributes.name: Throughput near
attributes.description: The router throughput (speed) of the communications is measured very near the router in an "open space" hallway. For our test, it was 8 feet away from the router in a hallway. For Mesh Routers, the client is placed 8 feet from the base. Performance will vary based on the size and construction of the house or apartment and how many floors, walls, doors, and other obstructions are between the router and receiving device.

attributes.name: Throughput mid-range
attributes.description: The router communications throughput (speed) is measured further away from the router but still in an "open space" hallway. For this test the client was 20 feet away from the router in a hallway. For Mesh Router's, the satellite is placed 20 feet from the base, and the client is placed 20 feet from the base while attached to the satellite. Performance will vary based on the size and construction of the house or apartment and how many floors, walls, doors, and other obstructions are between the router and receiving device.

attributes.name: Throughput far
attributes.description: The router communications throughput (speed) is measured far away from the router using an "open space" hallway. For this test, the distance is 55 feet away from the router in a hallway where the device is located around the corner from the router to obtain the 55 feet distance. For Mesh Routers, the satellite is placed 20 feet from the base, and the client is placed around the corner to negotiate the 55 feet from the base router but attached to the satellite located 49.25 feet away. The performance will vary based on the size and construction of the house or apartment; and how many floors, walls, doors, and other obstructions are between the router and receiving device.

attributes.name: Versatility
attributes.description: Includes hardware features such as orientation choices (if router can be wall mounted), number of LAN ports, QoS, parental controls, number and type of USB ports, tech support and warranty provisions. It also includes how a user manages the router through a web browser and/or a smartphone app.

attributes.name: Ease of setup
attributes.description: A rating of setup features such as a smartphone app based setup feature, web browser based setup feature with a wizard, status LEDs, WiFi protected setup, and guest network presence and setup.

attributes.name: Height
attributes.description: The height of the router measured to the nearest tenth of an inch.

attributes.name: Width
attributes.description: The width of the router measured to the nearest tenth of an inch.

attributes.name: Depth
attributes.description: The depth of the router measured to the nearest tenth of an inch.

attributes.name: Weight
attributes.description: The weight of the router measured to the nearest tenth of a pound.

attributes.name: Warranty length
attributes.description: The length in months of the manufacturer's standard warranty.

attributes.name: Supports WPS
attributes.description: WiFi Protected Setup (previously called WiFi Simple Config) is a network standard designed to ease the setup of security-enabled WiFi networks in the home. With it, you don't have to remember the username and password to connect a new device wirelessly, and it eliminates the need to give out your password to guests. WiFi Protected Setup supports methods (pushing a button, entering a PIN into a wizard-type application, Near Field Communication (NFC) Cards, and USB Flash Drives) that are familiar to most consumers to configure a network and enable WPA or WPA2 security.

attributes.name: Guest network
attributes.description: A guest network is a wireless network separate from your home network. It allows visitors, friends, or family access to your Internet connection without giving them access to your network. With a guest network, you don't have to give them your home network password and potential access to your computers on the network. We report which, if any, network frequency band the router can set up a guest network on.

attributes.name: Parental controls
attributes.description: Parental Controls can block inappropriate and dangerous sites, restrict access by time,  and category (adult, gaming, social media, etc.). Since it's enabled on the router, it can control every device on your home network.

attributes.name: Prioritization
attributes.description: Also called "Quality of Service" and typically abbreviated as QoS, it refers to being able to adjust the router to give more or less priority to different types of data moving across the network. For example, you can give higher priority to streaming video and online demanding games. In that case if someone is streaming a video and someone else is playing an online game, those computers will get more of the Internet bandwidth allocated to them. If someone else then needs to download a file, that download may go a bit slower, but the video and game won't be affected.

attributes.name: Ethernet cable included
attributes.description: Whether or not the router includes an Ethernet cable in the box.

attributes.name: Automatic firmware updates
attributes.description: Router automatically downloads and installs of new firmware, and it could include performance or security updates without user intervention.

attributes.name: Smartphone setup app
attributes.description: Router has a smartphone app for iOS and Android so you can set up the router from your smartphone.

attributes.name: Wall mountable
attributes.description: Whether or not the router can be mounted on a wall.

attributes.name: Gigabit Ethernet
attributes.description: Support for 1000 Mb/s networking.

attributes.name: Number of LAN ports
attributes.description: The total number of LAN ports on the router, LAN ports are the ones used to wire a computer to the router using an Ethernet cable.

attributes.name: Number of USB ports
attributes.description: Number of USB ports for printers, flash drives, or other peripherals.

attributes.name: Print server
attributes.description: A print server is a device that connects printers to other computers over a network. Many routers have built-in print servers. Typically you connect your printer to the USB port on the router and use a print utility to share it over the network wirelessly.

expertReview.summary: A 15.6-inch laptop tested with Windows 10 Home, an Intel Core i7-11800H 2.3GHz processor, 16GB of memory, 4GB Nvidia GeForce RTX3050Ti graphics, and a 512GB solid-state drive.
expertReview.bottomLine: The Acer Predator Helios 300 PH315-54-748Y is a 15.6-inch laptop, and its performance speeds are one of the fastest among rated models that make it suitable for gaming. It comes with an Intel Core i7-11800H 2.3GHz processor, 16GB RAM, 512GB solid-state drive, Nvidia GeForce RTX3050Ti video adapter with 4GB dedicated memory, and integrated Intel UHD graphics. Its battery life is reasonable at 7 hours in web browsing tests, and its results were below-average from other models of similar size. Its display has good contrast, a matte display that can cut down on distracting glare in bright rooms, but a narrow range of colors.
expertReview.highs:
• Shows fast speeds in our performance tests
• Comes with a large amount of total storage space
• Comes with a fast, more efficient solid-state drive
expertReview.lows:
• Short battery life might not last a full day's work
• No optical drive
• Lacks a memory card reader
expertReview.description:
The Acer Predator Helios 300 PH315-54-748Y is a 15.6-inch laptop with a screen resolution of 1920 x 1080. It has 16GB of memory and a 512GB solid-state drive. It has an Intel Core i7-11800H 2.3GHz processor and Nvidia GeForce RTX3050Ti video adapter with 4GB dedicated memory, and integrated Intel UHD Graphics. It lacks an optical drive for burning CDs or DVDs. It was tested with Windows 10 Home installed.

It has 3 full-size, 1 type-C USB ports built-in on the laptop. Video outputs include: an HDMI full-size port, a miniDP port, supporting Thunderbolt 4 (40 Gbps) over USB-C. It supports WiFi 5 (802.11ac), so it's compatible with high-speed routers. It also supports WiFi 6 (802.11ax), which provides faster and more dependable High Efficiency Wireless, but you'll need a compatible router to see the faster speeds. Gigabit ethernet is built-in on the laptop. It has Bluetooth 5.2 built-in. It has a 0.9MP webcam for video conferencing.

The Acer Predator Helios 300 PH315-54-748Y measures 14.2 inches wide by 10.2 inches deep by 1.1 inches high, and it weighs 4.8 lbs. It's backed by a 12-month warranty, with 12 months of free tech support over telephone.
expertReview.review:
Performance: Overall this laptop's performance was Very Good. Tasks like email, word processing and web browsing will be accomplished quickly. Compared to other tested laptops, it was fast for common tasks such as web browsing and video conferencing. Applications start up quickly. It was fast when composing documents with images, calculating large data spreadsheets, and running other productivity tasks, and it was fast for manipulating filters on multiple images, converting and editing videos, and rendering 3D models and calculating simulations. Its playback was smoother than most other tested laptops, even when video game settings were maxed out. With hybrid graphics, the laptop can dynamically switch to the dedicated graphics card when a performance boost is needed for demanding games or applications. Everyday tasks, like web browsing or playing videos, will default to the integrated graphics chip, which is more power efficient and can reduce noise and extend battery life.

Portability: This laptop is a Good choice for traveling, although not ideal. Battery life lasted 7 hours in a light load of web browsing tests, and 4.5 hours in a heavier load of 4K video playback tests. Results were sufficient to get through most of a workday of mixed use tasks, but not as notable as similar laptops. At 4.8 lbs, weight was typical for a laptop of this size category.

Ergonomics: The laptop features, such as its keyboard, touchpad, and labeling were well-designed, making it comfortable and convenient to use. The keyboard has large keys and was comfortably sized. Its high contrast letters were easy to read, and the backlighting can be useful in dark rooms. There's a dedicated number pad for faster data entry. The power button was well labeled and conveniently located.

Display: The display quality was Very Good overall. Colors were in the ballpark, though not completely accurate. The display was anti-reflective, so there was little or no glare when viewing in a brightly lit room or outdoors. The display has a wide viewing angle, especially important if more than one person needs to see the screen at a time, say, for a video or presentation. Its display produces a smaller array of colors than on most other tested laptops.

Useful features and attributes on this model include: The 512GB solid-state drive uses less power and accesses data more quickly than conventional hard-disk drives. You can connect common external devices such as hard drives and Blu-ray burners using Thunderbolt 4 (40 Gbps) for maximum performance. Gigabit ethernet provides fast transfer of data over a local network. This laptop has a full-size HDMI port and a miniDP port for connecting to an HDTV or monitor.

Downsides: There's no optical drive like a CD or DVD reader, so you'll have to buy an external drive if you need one. There is no memory-card reader, so you'll need to buy an external reader or connect your digital camera directly to this laptop to transfer photos.

expertReview.summary: A 16.0-inch laptop tested with Windows 10 Home, an Intel Core i7-11800H 2.3GHz processor, 16GB of memory, 8GB Nvidia GeForce RTX3080 graphics, and a 1TB solid-state drive.
expertReview.bottomLine: The Acer Predator Triton 500 SE PT516-51s-71Q2 is a 16-inch laptop, and its performance speeds are faster than average rated models to perform most tasks demanded. Its battery life is below average but reasonable at 10.25 hours in web browsing tests models of similar size. The display scores Excellent with near accurate colors and a matte display that can cut down on distracting glare in bright rooms.
expertReview.highs:
• Shows fast speeds in our performance tests
• Able to play demanding video games
• Comes with a large amount of total storage space
• Comes with a fast, more efficient solid-state drive
• Has a fingerprint reader
expertReview.lows: • No optical drive
expertReview.description:
The Acer Predator Triton 500 SE PT516-51s-71Q2 is a 16-inch laptop with a screen resolution of 2560 x 1600. It has 16GB of memory and a 1TB solid-state drive. It has an Intel Core i7-11800H 2.3GHz processor and Nvidia GeForce RTX3080 video adapter with 8GB dedicated memory, and integrated Intel UHD Graphics. It lacks an optical drive for burning CDs or DVDs. It was tested with Windows 10 Home installed.

It has 2 full-size, 2 type-C USB ports built-in on the laptop. Video outputs include: an HDMI full-size port, supporting Thunderbolt 4 (40 Gbps) over USB-C. It supports WiFi 5 (802.11ac), so it's compatible with high-speed routers. It also supports WiFi 6 (802.11ax), which provides faster and more dependable High Efficiency Wireless, but you'll need a compatible router to see the faster speeds. 2.5Gb ethernet is built-in on the laptop. It has Bluetooth (vers not spec) built-in. It has a 0.9MP webcam for video conferencing. The ethernet port claims support for up to 2.5Gb speed.

The Acer Predator Triton 500 SE PT516-51s-71Q2 measures 14.1 inches wide by 10.4 inches deep by 1 inches high, and it weighs 5.2 lbs. It's backed by a 12-month warranty, with 12 months of free tech support over telephone.
expertReview.review:
Performance: Overall this laptop's performance was Very Good. Tasks like email, word processing and web browsing will be accomplished quickly. Compared to other tested laptops, it was fast for common tasks such as web browsing and video conferencing. Applications start up quickly. It was fast when composing documents with images, calculating large data spreadsheets, and running other productivity tasks, and it was among the fastest for manipulating filters on multiple images, converting and editing videos, and rendering 3D models and calculating simulations. In addition, demanding video games will show smooth graphics and have a quick response. Its playback was smoother than most other tested laptops, even when video game settings were maxed out. With hybrid graphics, the laptop can dynamically switch to the dedicated graphics card when a performance boost is needed for demanding games or applications. Everyday tasks, like web browsing or playing videos, will default to the integrated graphics chip, which is more power efficient and can reduce noise and extend battery life.

Portability: This laptop is a Good choice for traveling, although not ideal. Battery life lasted 10.25 hours in a light load of web browsing tests, and 6.25 hours in a heavier load of 4K video playback tests. Results could get you through a typical workday, under a workload of mixed use. At 5.2 lbs, weight was typical for a laptop of this size category.

Ergonomics: Some features of the keyboard, touchpad, and labeling, were well-designed, and were comfortable or convenient to use. The keyboard has large keys and was comfortably sized. Its high contrast letters were easy to read, and the backlighting can be useful in dark rooms. The power button was well labeled and conveniently located.

Display: The display quality was Excellent overall. Colors were accurately reproduced, realistic, and natural looking. The laptop's display was brighter than most and it's anti-reflective, a plus for viewing in a brightly lit room or outdoors. The display has a wide viewing angle, especially important if more than one person needs to see the screen at a time, say, for a video or presentation.

Useful features and attributes on this model include: The spacious 1TB offers plenty of room for storing your music, photos, and movies. The 1TB solid-state drive uses less power and accesses data more quickly than conventional hard-disk drives. You can connect common external devices such as hard drives and Blu-ray burners using Thunderbolt 4 (40 Gbps) for maximum performance. The fingerprint reader lets you log into your computer without typing in a password. 2.5Gb ethernet provides fast transfer of data over a local network. This laptop has a full-size HDMI port for connecting to an HDTV or monitor. At about 12.1 ft length, the power cable is longer than most others, so you can worry less about power outlet locations.

Downsides: There's no optical drive like a CD or DVD reader, so you'll have to buy an external drive if you need one. The power supply and chassis are heavier than the average weight of a comparable laptop and power supply.

expertReview.summary: A 14.0-inch convertible laptop tested with Windows 10 Home, an Intel Core i5-1035G1 1GHz processor, 8GB of memory, Intel UHD Graphics graphics, a touchscreen, and a 256GB solid-state drive.
expertReview.bottomLine: The Acer Spin 3 is a 14-inch laptop with a touchscreen display. Performance speeds are Very Good for complex productivity work, but you might notice a slowdown during more demanding video games or graphical tasks. Its battery life is among the lowest for its size category. Its convertible screen has wide viewing angles, but colors appear pale and somewhat off-tone.
expertReview.highs:
• Touchscreen provides a convenient way to navigate and interact
• Comes with a fast, more efficient solid-state drive
• Has a fingerprint reader
expertReview.lows:
• Compared to typical hard drives, this solid-state drive provides less storage space
• No optical drive
expertReview.description:
The Acer Spin 3 SP314-54N-53BF is a 14-inch convertible laptop with a screen resolution of 1920 x 1080. It has 8GB of memory and a 256GB solid-state drive. It has an Intel Core i5-1035G1 1GHz processor and an integrated Intel UHD Graphics. It lacks an optical drive for burning CDs or DVDs. It was tested with Windows 10 Home installed.

It has a touch screen, 2 full-size, 1 type-C USB ports built-in on the laptop. Video outputs include: an HDMI full-size port, supporting Thunderbolt 3 (40 Gbps) over USB-C. It supports WiFi 5 (802.11ac), so it's compatible with high-speed routers. It also supports WiFi 6 (802.11ax), which provides faster and more dependable High Efficiency Wireless, but you'll need a compatible router to see the faster speeds. It has a 0.9MP webcam for video conferencing. It has a built-in holder that recharges the active stylus.

The Acer Spin 3 SP314-54N-53BF measures 12.8 inches wide by 9.1 inches deep by 0.8 inches high, and it weighs 3.4 lbs. It's backed by a 12-month warranty, with 12 months of free tech support over telephone.
expertReview.review:
Performance: Overall this laptop's performance was only Fair, well below that of many models but still good enough for routine tasks like email, word processing and web browsing. Compared to other tested laptops, its speed was adequate for common tasks such as web browsing, video conferencing, and application startup. Performance was okay but on the slow side when composing documents, working on data spreadsheets, and running other productivity tasks, and it was so slow that it was difficult to manipulate images, edit videos, and calculate simulations.

Portability: This laptop is a Good choice for traveling, although not ideal. Battery life lasted 10.5 hours in a light load of web browsing tests, and 6.25 hours in a heavier load of 4K video playback tests. Results could get you through a typical workday, under a workload of mixed use. At 3.4 lbs, weight was typical for a laptop of this size category.

Ergonomics: Some features of the keyboard, touchpad, and labeling, were well-designed, and were comfortable or convenient to use. The keyboard has large keys and was comfortably sized. Its high contrast letters were easy to read, and the backlighting can be useful in dark rooms. The power button was well-labeled, but it was inconveniently placed, either difficult to reach or too easy to accidentally press. A stylus is included for use with the touch screen. The keyboard can be folded away, allowing the screen to be used like a tablet. The touchscreen is smooth enough for fast swipes, and fingerprints clean off easily. Testers liked the sturdy build of the chassis.

Display: The display quality was Very Good overall. Colors were in the ballpark, though not completely accurate. The display has a wide viewing angle, especially important if more than one person needs to see the screen at a time, say, for a video or presentation. Its display produces a smaller array of colors than on most other tested laptops.

Useful features and attributes on this model include: Laptop converts to a touchscreen tablet to be used as either a laptop computer or a tablet. The 256GB solid-state drive uses less power and accesses data more quickly than conventional hard-disk drives. You can connect common external devices such as hard drives and Blu-ray burners using Thunderbolt 3 (40 Gbps) for maximum performance. The fingerprint reader lets you log into your computer without typing in a password. This laptop has a full-size HDMI port for connecting to an HDTV or monitor.

Downsides: There's no optical drive like a CD or DVD reader, so you'll have to buy an external drive if you need one.
